raw.excerpt: About the BusinessQuilter plc is a leading wealth management business, helping to enable brighter financial futures for every generation.
raw.description:
About the Business

Quilter plc is a leading wealth management business, helping to enable brighter financial futures for every generation.

Quilter oversees £157.4 billion in customer investments (as of August 2026). It has an adviser and customer offering spanning financial advice, investment platforms, multi-asset investment solutions, and discretionary fund management. The business is comprised of two segments: Affluent and High Net Worth.

Affluent encompasses the financial planning business, Quilter Financial Planning, the Quilter Investment Platform and Quilter Investors, the multi-asset investment solutions business.

High Net Worth includes the discretionary fund management business, Quilter Cheviot, together with Quilter Cheviot Financial Planning – offering a highly personalised service to private clients, charities, trustees, and professional partners. Quilter Cheviot has presence throughout the UK, Ireland and Channel Islands.

At Quilter we never stand still. Our foundations are rooted in our extraordinary expertise, which is trusted by hundreds of thousands of customers, but we have great ambitions to stay one step ahead and make an even greater difference to the people and communities we serve, including our colleagues.

Our business is transforming, continually modernising, and becoming even more customer centric. So, if you want to be bold in the pursuit of your ambitions, bring new ideas, and challenge and evolve what we do, it’s the perfect time to join us!

About the Role

Level: Level 4

Department: Supervision & Oversight (QFP)

Location: Home-based

Contract type: Permanent, Full-Time

As a Firm Compliance Partner within Quilter Financial Planning, you will provide regulatory oversight for a varied portfolio of appointed representative firms. Your portfolio will include routine firms and smaller bespoke businesses that are suitable for primarily remote supervision, with occasional travel where the circumstances or risk profile of a firm require it.

You will take end-to-end ownership of your firms, building effective working relationships with Firm Principals and developing a strong understanding of how their businesses operate. You will provide practical support and guidance while retaining the independence and confidence to challenge constructively where regulatory requirements or Network standards are not being met.

You will plan and complete firm attestation reviews and governance assessments, using evidence and professional judgement to assess each firm’s governance, systems and controls. Where concerns or weaknesses are identified, you will agree proportionate action plans, establish clear timescales and monitor progress through to completion.

You will take ownership of identified issues through to an appropriate conclusion, escalating material concerns through the relevant channels when required. You will also support the pre-vetting of firms looking to join Quilter, assessing compliance and conduct risks, providing appropriate challenge and contributing to informed onboarding decisions.

The decisions you make will directly support good customer outcomes by helping firms identify weaknesses early, strengthen their controls and deliver advice and ongoing service to the standards customers should expect.

This is a home-based role where supervision is delivered primarily through Microsoft Teams. You will plan and manage your own workload while contributing to a highly skilled and collaborative team.

Occasional travel will be required where this is appropriate to the needs of the firm or the supervision being undertaken.

About You

You will be a confident communicator, particularly skilled in questioning, and be able to display sound judgment when assessing risks and developing action plans. You will also have strong analytical approach and inquisitive nature.

You will bring a wealth of existing experience working within a compliance role and be competent in providing feedback to advisers/firm principals.

Experience of Network/National and IFA/restricted advice models is desirable.

A Compliance & Risk qualification is essential, and all candidates must be QCF Level 4 or equivalent.


#Quilter

Inclusion & Diversity

We value diversity and strive to promote inclusivity in all aspects of our culture. We believe in equal opportunities for all, ensuring that no applicant encounters less favourable treatment based on anything but their skills, qualifications, experience, and potential. We celebrate the unique contributions of a diverse workforce and create a respectful, nurturing environment where every colleague can thrive.

Values

Do the right thing: We act with integrity and are proudly committed to going above and beyond in service of our clients and the support we provide our communities.
Always curious: We continuously seek new ideas and knowledge so we’re one step ahead of our clients’ needs. We look for inspiration everywhere and encourage experimentation, recognising that this is how we create brilliant solutions for brighter futures.
Embrace challenge: We aim high to transform our potential into meaningful outcomes. With ambition as our driving force and a steadfast commitment to growth, we succeed for the good of every generation.
Stronger together: Combining our diverse talents, we accomplish more collectively than we ever could do alone. We speak openly, actively listen, and support each other, and constructively challenge and embrace new ideas. We seek empowerment and demonstrate ownership and trust, with the confidence to make impactful decisions.

Core Benefits

Holiday: 182 hours (26 days)

Quilter Incentive Scheme: All employees are eligible to participate in incentive scheme, to incentivise business performance and their contribution.

Pension Scheme: A non-contributory company pension scheme that can be boosted through personal contributions.

Private Medical Insurance: Single cover as standard with options to increase cover to include your partner or children.

Life Assurance: 4x your salary.

Income Protection: 75% of salary, less state benefits, payable after 26 weeks of absence.

Healthcare Cash Plan: Jersey employees only

In addition to our core benefits, we offer a range of flexible benefits to UK employees that you can choose from and pay for conveniently via a salary deduction.

raw.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need?

As Manager, Professional Services, North America, you will lead a team of technical and scientific Professional Services consultants delivering complex solutions to our enterprise R&D customers.

This role has a particular focus on Lab Orchestration. You will bring experience of laboratory automation, instrument integration and scientific workflows, helping Dotmatics develop and scale its Lab Orchestration services capability while ensuring successful delivery for our customers.

You will combine strong people leadership, customer consulting and commercial Services management with sufficient technical and domain expertise to provide direction and challenge on complex implementations. You will work closely with customers and with Sales, Solutions, Product, Engineering and Project Management throughout the customer lifecycle, from early solution definition and proof of concept through implementation, adoption and expansion.

As an inspiring manager, you will build a high-performing team, develop individual capabilities and career paths, and create an environment in which consultants can deliver consistently high-quality outcomes. You will have particular responsibility for developing Lab Orchestration capability within the team, coaching specialists and helping establish repeatable implementation approaches, standards and best practices.

You will also play an important role in evolving how Professional Services operates. We are looking for someone who can combine the fundamentals of running a successful Services organisation with a forward-looking approach to automation, AI-enabled delivery, reusable intellectual property and scalable service offerings.

In this role you will get to

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of technical and scientific Professional Services professionals across North America.
  • Build capability within the team through coaching, career development, skills planning and recruitment.
  • Provide leadership and subject-matter guidance for Lab Orchestration and laboratory automation engagements, including instrument integration, scientific data flows and laboratory workflow transformation.
  • Support the development of Dotmatics' Lab Orchestration delivery methodology, implementation patterns, best practices and reusable knowledge.
  • Provide oversight and governance for complex and strategic customer programmes, particularly where multiple technologies, workstreams or delivery teams are involved.
  • Lead or support strategic customer engagements from discovery and proof of concept through implementation and production adoption.
  • Act as a senior consultant to customers, helping translate scientific and laboratory workflows into practical technical and service solutions.
  • Work closely with Sales and Solutions teams during pre-contract and solution-definition activities to ensure proposed solutions are achievable, appropriately scoped and commercially viable.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to provide structured feedback from customer implementations and help shape capabilities required to successfully deploy and operate Lab Orchestration solutions.
  • Encourage new and scalable approaches to Services delivery, including automation, AI-assisted delivery, reusable assets and standardised offerings.
  • Develop and standardise Professional Services offerings that improve customer outcomes while increasing delivery predictability and scalability.
  • Drive utilisation, revenue and margin performance across the team.
  • Review commercial delivery plans to maximise margin while protecting customer outcomes and delivery quality.
  • Review Statements of Work and Services agreements in partnership with Sales and Legal, providing Services, delivery and contractual input where appropriate.
  • Monitor project and contract performance, including Work in Progress, forecast, delivery risk and financial performance.
  • Manage subcontractors and delivery partners where appropriate, ensuring quality and accountability remain consistent with Dotmatics standards.
  • Conduct solution and delivery peer reviews on strategically important or high-risk engagements.
  • Identify operational improvements that increase quality, repeatability, efficiency and scalability across Professional Services.
  • Communicate and collaborate effectively within a multinational, cross-functional organisation including Project Management, Solutions Architects, Application Scientists, Developers, Sales, Engineering, Customer Success and Product.

We are looking for people who have significant experience within Professional Services, consulting or enterprise technology delivery, combined with demonstrated people leadership experience.

The ideal candidate will have worked within scientific software, laboratory informatics, laboratory automation or a related enterprise SaaS environment, and will understand both the commercial realities of Professional Services and the complexities of delivering technology into scientific R&D organisations.

The key skills we are looking for

  • Leading, coaching and developing technical or scientific Professional Services teams.
  • Laboratory automation, Lab Orchestration, scientific instrument integration or closely related laboratory technologies.
  • Understanding laboratory workflows and translating scientific and operational requirements into implementable solutions.
  • Delivering complex enterprise SaaS, laboratory informatics or scientific software implementations.
  • Working across interconnected laboratory systems, instruments, software and scientific data workflows.
  • Acting as a trusted consultant to enterprise customers and engaging confidently with both scientific and technical stakeholders.
  • Supporting complex solutions through discovery, proof of concept, implementation and production adoption.
  • Working collaboratively with Sales, Solutions, Product and Engineering during pre-contract, implementation and post-implementation phases.
  • Providing technical or architectural oversight without needing to personally own every aspect of solution delivery.
  • Managing Services financial performance, including utilisation, revenue, margin and delivery forecasting.
  • Developing repeatable methodologies, reusable assets or standardised Services offerings.
  • Identifying opportunities to use automation and emerging technologies, including AI, to improve the efficiency and scalability of Professional Services delivery.
  • Managing multiple concurrent customer engagements and identifying delivery, technical and commercial risk.
  • Operating effectively in a global, matrixed organisation with stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies.

You may also have

  • Laboratory robotics and automation platforms.
  • Scientific instrument connectivity and integration.
  • Laboratory informatics environments involving ELN, LIMS, SDMS, CDS or related scientific systems.
  • Designing or implementing end-to-end laboratory workflows spanning multiple instruments and software platforms.
  • Building new consulting or Professional Services capabilities within an emerging technology area.
  • Developing services that scale beyond traditional time-and-materials consulting through standardisation, automation or reusable intellectual property.
  • Working within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, chemicals or other scientific R&D organisations.

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

Solenis is a leading global producer of specialty chemicals focused on delivering sustainable solutions for water-intensive industries, including consumer, industrial, institutional, food and beverage, and pool and spa water markets. Owned by Platinum Equity, the company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, and cleaners and disinfectants, as well as state-of-the-art monitoring and control systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments.

Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company has 69 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over 16,500 professionals in 160 countries across six continents. Solenis is a 2025 US Best Managed Company, recognized five years in a row. For more information about Solenis, please visit www.solenis.com.

We are looking for a Area Manager to join our Ontario, Canada Team!

What You'll Do

  • Lead, support, and develop a team of roughly 4-6 sales representatives to achieve targeted total sales, gross profit, technical, equipment & service programs.
  • Partner with your team to deliver on district sales goals and budget commitments.
  • Coach and mentor others by providing clear guidance and constructive feedback to strengthen commercial, technical, and business capabilities.
  • Foster consistency by ensuring alignment with systems, policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, manage costs, continuously strengthen business processes and drive value at customers and prospects
  • Implement and support performance planning and development conversations.
  • Collaborate closely with key customers, large/local accounts, and Key Account Managers, with clearly defined plans and shared accountability for execution.
  • Serve as a trusted technical and commercial partner to customer QA, operations, and food safety teams.
  • This is a remote position based from a home office, requiring travel up to 50% of the time.

Required Technical Expertise (Mandatory)

  • This role requires hands-on, practical experience within all market segments of F&B including, dairy, brewing, beverage, processed foods, pharma and intervention applications in beef, pork and/or poultry processing.
  • In addition to knowledge of Cleaning & Sanitizing (C&S), Water Treatment, and Food Safety, qualified candidates must have real-world experience with chemistry applications, food safety & microbiology, and equipment dosing applications and installations
  • Excellent working knowledge of SFDC (Salesforce), Workday, Tableau (data mining software), Microsoft Office 365 Platform and AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT

What You'll Bring

  • A university or college degree and experience selling in a B2B environment (specialty chemical sales preferred), with 2–3 years of experience leading or managing a sales team.
  • A commitment to continuous learning and ongoing development of commercial and technical expertise.
  • Fully bilingual in French and English
  • The ability to translate strategic priorities into clear, achievable actions and responsibilities.
  • A collaborative mindset and a genuine desire to contribute to team success.
  • Strong relationship-building skills across customer organizations and internal partners.
  • Alignment with our company vision and values, with the ability to clearly communicate and reinforce them with your team.
  • A flexible, inclusive leadership style that motivates others and supports high performance.
  • Comfort using data and insights to make thoughtful, informed decisions.
  • A focus on setting clear expectations while creating opportunities for team members to grow and build skills that support both current and future success.

Perks!  

  • Competitive health + wellness benefit plan  
  • Continuous professional development with many opportunities for growth!  
  • Recharge with PTO, Sick Time and Floating Holidays  
  • Competitive Salary and Sales Incentive Plan
  • Company Defined Contribution Pension Plan
  • Company Car, Laptop, Phone
  • The successful candidate will have the flexibility to work from home during non-travel periods.

We understand that candidates will not meet every single desired qualification. If your experience looks a little different from what we’ve identified and you think you can bring value to the role, we’d love to learn more about you.

At Solenis, we understand that our greatest asset is our people. That is why we offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits which include health, dental, vision and a defined contribution pension plan, and numerous opportunities for professional growth and development. So, if you are interested in working for a world-class company and enjoy solving complex challenges, whether in the lab or the field, consider joining our team.

raw.title: Marketing Strategist
raw.excerpt: Job Description The CompanyWe’re Tallwave, a growth partner that helps organizations turn disconnected growth efforts into connected growth systems.
raw.description:
Job Description

The Company

We’re Tallwave, a growth partner that helps organizations turn disconnected growth efforts into connected growth systems. We’re a curious, ambitious team of strategic thinkers and creative problem solvers who understand our clients’ worlds deeply, challenge assumptions, and work across disciplines to solve the constraints holding growth back. We move with speed and discipline, embrace innovation, and hold ourselves accountable for meaningful outcomes. Our ambitions are too big to leave room for individual egos, so we value ownership, humility, selflessness, and the belief that our greatest success comes from what we can accomplish together.

The Person

Tallwave seeks out individuals who are a cut above. Their exceptional skill, diverse perspectives, obsession for winning together, and relentless pursuit of continuous self-improvement, both professionally and personally, give them an innate ability to lead, innovate, and inspire. They have well-honed philosophies and points of view in their areas of expertise, they think unconventionally, and their endless curiosity pushes them to constantly explore, learn, improve, and try new things.

The Job

We’re looking for a Marketing Strategist who can turn complex business and marketing problems into clear strategies that help teams execute.. You’ll help our clients understand where growth is constrained, who they need to reach, what they need to believe or do differently, and which marketing, experience, and channel decisions will have the greatest impact.

You’ll work across different growth models, from consumer brands sold through retail to subscription businesses to B2B companies selling through a buying committee. You’ll learn to recognize the economics and customer journey of each model before recommending what to do.

You’ll connect business strategy to marketing execution across positioning, messaging, audience, content, demand generation, digital experience, conversion, and measurement. You’ll work closely with strategists, designers, marketing engineers, and client teams to turn recommendations into action—and you’ll use data and research to continuously improve the plan.

This is a hands-on strategy role. We’re not looking for someone who wants to create decks and hand them off. You’ll participate in the research, analysis, workshops, planning, briefs, recommendations, and measurement that make the strategy real.

You will report to the Head of Delivery for now who runs the delivery practice, while working closely with practitioners across strategy, product design, and marketing and AI visibility. This role is an opportunity to help shape how Tallwave delivers modern, AI-enabled marketing strategy across our clients.

The Skills

The successful candidate will:

  • Diagnose the real growth constraint before accepting the clients brief, using the right business and marketing signals to understand where growth is being limited
  • Develop positioning, messaging hierarchy, and audience strategy and frameworks, grounded in competitive, customer and market researchConduct and synthesize buyer and customer research, including interviews, win/loss, review,sales-call mining, surveys, and behavioral data
  • Translate research and data into clear audience segments, customer needs, jobs-to-be-done, and actionable marketing opportunities.
  • Map the customer journey using available behavioral, CRM, web, commerce and marketing data and identify moments that influence awareness, consideration, conversion and retention.
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion and customer experience, partnering with product designers and marketing engineers to turn strategic recommendations into better digital experiences.
  • Translate positioning and strategy into an integrated message and content architecture across owned, earned, retailer, paid, and sales-enablement surfaces, with briefs the content team and marketing engineer can execute
  • Develop integrated marketing plans that connect brand, demand generation, content, paid media, SEO/AI visibility, conversion, and customer experience around a common business objective.
  • Build business cases and prioritize marketing investments using practical financial and performance metrics appropriate to the client’s business model
  • Develop t channel recommendations across consumer platforms such as Meta, Google, YouTube, CTV, retail media, and B2B platforms such as LinkedIn, ABM, review sites and other relevant channels
  • Understand the role of AI-powered discovery in the modern customer journey and incorporate AI search visibility, generative AI, and AI-assisted research into strategy where appropriate.
  • Develop the measurement plans that connect marketing activity to meaningful business outcomes and use available data to evaluate performance, identify learning and recommend optimization.
  • Build clear strategic recommendations and present them confidently to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Contribute to engagement delivery from strategy through execution, partnering with the PM on workplans, resourcing, timelines, budgets, and quality.
  • Facilitate working sessions that help clients align across marketing, sales, product, creative, digital, and other agency partners.
  • Work closely with the Marketing Engineer to identify opportunities for automation, AI Visibility, experimentation, analytics, and technical implementation.
  • Use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate research, synthesis, analysis, ideation, and strategic development while applying sound judgment to the outputs.
  • Identify the next problem worth solving before the client asks

The Requirements

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 3–5 years of experience in marketing strategy, growth marketing, digital strategy, integrated marketing, agency strategy, or a related discipline.
  • Experience developing marketing strategies that move beyond a single channel and connect audience, positioning, messaging, channels, content, experience, and measurement.
  • Demonstrated work across more than one growth model (consumer and B2B, or direct and retail), with a clear view of what works and what does not
  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business problems into structured hypotheses, research questions, recommendations, and actionable plans.
  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, campaign strategy, customer journeys, or integrated marketing plans.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data from tools such as GA4, CRM platforms, marketing automation platforms, research tools, or other business intelligence sources.
  • Working knowledge of paid media, SEO, content, CRM/lifecycle marketing, conversion optimization, and other major marketing channels—you do not need to be a channel specialist, but you need to understand how the pieces work together.
  • Strong understanding of how modern buyers discover, evaluate, and choose brands across search, social, AI assistants, marketplaces, websites, and other digital experiences.
  • Experience collaborating with designers, developers, marketers, account/project managers, and client stakeholders to move strategy into execution.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex information into a clear story and recommendation. Nice to haves include:
  • Familiarity with AI search visibility and how positioning affects what assistants recommend
  • Daily working use of Claude or similar tools for research synthesis and analysis

The Culture and Perks of Being a Tallwaver:

raw.description:
At DIGITALL we dont just deliver technology we deliver the future! We are explorers, knowledge-hunters, tech geeks, problem solvers and game changers who want to inspire and be inspired. Our DIGITALL people are always one step forward: working with top-notch technologies, creating innovations ahead of the market trends, sharing the passion for discovering better ways. As a human-centric organization, our teams are built on mutual respect and open communication, allowing everyone to be authentic, express ideas and unleash their potential. We are proud of our DIGITALL bright minds and never stop developing their skills to keep pushing boundaries together and do what we love. DIGITALL operates globally with a team of 1000 experts in 16 locations across 8 countries.

﻿We are seeking an AI/ML Engineer to build and operationalize AI solutions across RAG, agentic workflows, knowledge graphs, and machine learning. The role is hands-on and spans experimentation, backend development, deployment, evaluation, and production support.

This is your job:

  • ﻿Design and build RAG and agentic AI solutions from prototype through production;
  • Develop AI workflows using Python, LangGraph, LangChain, or comparable frameworks;
  • Build backend services and APIs using FastAPI, REST APIs, and containerized deployment patterns;
  • Develop retrieval pipelines covering ingestion, embeddings, indexing, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citations;
  • Support GraphRAG and knowledge graph use cases that combine structured and unstructured information;
  • Build and maintain data and AI pipelines using Databricks;
  • Integrate AI applications with Azure and enterprise services, including identity, security, logging, and monitoring;
  • Evaluate solution quality using retrieval metrics, RAG evaluations, LLM-based evaluation, and human review;
  • Collaborate with engineers, architects, product teams, and domain specialists to move use cases into production;
  • Support technical documentation, troubleshooting, optimization, and post-production improvements.

Your qualifications:

  • 3+ years of relevant software, data, machine learning, or AI engineering experience;
  • Strong programming capability in Python and experience building production APIs or backend services;
  • Hands-on experience with RAG, LLM applications, or agentic AI workflows;
  • Experience with FastAPI, REST APIs, Docker, Azure DevOps Git, and CI/CD;
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based application deployment;
  • Familiarity with Databricks, data pipelines, SQL, and common Python data/ML libraries;
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, RBAC, secrets management, logging, and monitoring;
  • Experience evaluating AI systems through retrieval metrics, RAGAS or similar frameworks, or task-specific benchmarks;
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams;
  • Ability to take ownership and work iteratively from experimentation to secure, maintainable production solutions;
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Statistics, or a related technical field.

Preferred: Experience with GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, ontologies, graph databases, Azure AI services, MCP, or enterprise technology environments.

Organizational information:

﻿﻿All applications will be treated in strict confidentiality.
Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview.

description: At Trifecta, we are more than just a technology company.

raw.title: Sales Account Executive: Data & Snowflake Services
raw.excerpt: At Trifecta, we are more than just a technology company.
raw.description:
At Trifecta, we are more than just a technology company. We are a community of innovators, collaborators, and problem solvers dedicated to driving positive change in the world of technology. We are a dynamic organization that embraces diversity, fosters inclusion, and values the unique contributions of each of our Teammates. At Trifecta you will find a supportive and inclusive culture, endless opportunities for growth and development, and a vibrant community of passionate professionals dedicated to shaping the future.

We've been building and integrating enterprise systems for over 30 years. We're a Select Snowflake Partner with delivery practices across Snowflake, Salesforce, Salsify, AI, and custom development. Our consultants ship real work — that's what you'll be selling.

About The Role

As a Sales Account Executive, you'll own new business for our Snowflake and data services practice. You'll build pipeline, run complex sales cycles, and turn prospects into long-term clients.

Your best target list is companies that already own Snowflake. Budget is committed, and plenty of them stalled after the first migration — idle workloads, cost overruns, governance gaps, AI plans with no data foundation underneath. Your job is to find them, understand where they got stuck, and sell the work that unsticks them.

This role is for someone who generates their own pipeline, gets comfortable fast with technical buyers, and would rather scope a deal honestly than oversell it. As well someone who wants to continue to leverage their Snowflake experience.

What You'll Do

  • Prospect into the Snowflake install base. Find companies running Snowflake that aren't getting value from it. Outbound, referrals, Snowflake introductions — whatever gets you in the room. Qualify hard on where they're actually stuck.
  • Get wired into Snowflake's field org. Not just the AE. Their Customer Success teams see which accounts flatlined on consumption and are measured on fixing it — that's the same problem you're solving, so bring them a path. Same with their SEs, PS org, and partner managers. Know their quarter, know how they're paid, and make them look good.
  • Build your own top of funnel. Partner referrals are leverage, not a plan. You're expected to generate pipeline through disciplined outbound into target accounts.
  • Run full sales cycles. Discovery through negotiation and close. Multi-thread across the client's data, IT, and business leadership — and across Snowflake's team at the same time.
  • Scope honestly. You'll work directly with our delivery leads to size engagements. We'd rather lose a deal than sell something we can't deliver well. Our references are the reason we win the next one.
  • Sell consumption, not just projects. Frame engagements around the workloads they unlock and the platform spend they drive. That's how Snowflake evaluates partners, and how you get fed more deals.
  • Hit your number. Meet or exceed quota, keep the CRM current, and tell us what you're hearing in the market.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of B2B sales with a real outbound track record — self-sourced pipeline, not just closing marketing leads.
  • Proven experience selling professional services on data and/or analytics projects. Scoped engagements, not software licenses.
  • Experience selling to C-level and VP buyers across both IT and the business.
  • Working knowledge of the modern data stack. You don't need to write SQL, but you should hold your own on warehouse compute and cost, migrations off legacy platforms (Redshift, Teradata, on-prem EDW), and where data projects go sideways.
  • Solid foundational knowledge of how professional services engagements are sold and delivered.
  • Ability to articulate a POV and value add of Snowflake and other data related services.
  • Proficiency in CRM tools and running a disciplined pipeline.
  • Ability to travel as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Existing relationships inside Snowflake's field organization — AE, SE, Customer Success, Professional Services, or partner team.
  • Snowflake certifications, or experience with Snowpark, Cortex, or AI/ML workloads.
  • Background at a systems integrator or consultancy.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing, CPG, or retail data environments.
  • Certifications in a recognized sales methodology.

raw.description:
Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. (MPS) is one of the fastest growing companies in the Semiconductor industry. We are worldwide technical leaders in Integrated Power Semiconductors and Systems Power delivery architectures. At MPS, we cultivate creativity, are passionate about sustainability, and are committed to providing leading-edge products and innovation to our customers. Our portfolio of technology helps power our world ---come join our team and see how YOU can make a difference.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Technical Marketing Engineer (TME) to support the market adoption and customer success of our voltage regulator portfolio. In this role, you will become a vital product expert, helping translate chip capabilities into practical customer solutions. A key focus of this position is the proactive research of market requirements; you will actively engage with the industry to uncover unmet customer needs and emerging technical challenges, directly translating those insights into the features of our upcoming products. You will work closely with a diverse internal team—including IC designers, hardware developers, and applications engineering teams—to build evaluation boards, write datasheets, and support customers through schematic and layout integration. If you have a solid foundation in power electronics and love being hands-on with hardware while shaping product strategy, this role is for you.

Core Responsibilities

  • Market Requirements & Feature Mapping: Actively research the market and engage with customers to uncover unmet technical needs and trends, translating these insights directly into actionable feature definitions for next-generation products.
  • Cross-Functional Engineering Collaboration: Partner directly with chip designers and internal engineering teams to align customer-facing features with silicon architecture capabilities.
  • Evaluation Board & Kit Creation: Design, test, and deliver functional Evaluation Boards (EVBs) and Evaluation Kits (EVKs) to help customers benchmark and test our silicon.
  • Datasheet & Documentation Support: Assist in drafting, reviewing, and updating highly detailed product datasheets, application notes, and layout optimization guides.
  • New Product Input: Contribute to the initiation of new product developments by gathering market data and summarizing technical feedback from early customer engagements.
  • Product Expertise: Master all technical details of our voltage regulators to support customers through schematic reviews and PCB layout checks.
  • Application Mapping: Document and showcase key product advantages (such as efficiency and thermal performance) across specific target customer applications.

Required Qualifications

  • Lab & EDA Tools: Hands-on experience using PCB design software (e.g., Altium, Cadence) and standard lab equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, digital multimeters).
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to proactively interview customers and present technical hardware concepts clearly to both external buyers and internal design teams.
  • Language: Professional proficiency in English (working language).

Location

  • Preferred Locations: Finland or Sweden.

It is the policy of MPS to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

raw.title: Director, AI Platforms, Global
raw.excerpt: About VantageVantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises.
raw.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.


Artificial Intelligence Team

The Artificial Intelligence Team exists to amplify human potential through intelligent technology. We're building an AI-powered ecosystem that transforms how Vantage creates value, freeing our people from routine work so they can focus on innovation and strategic thinking that truly differentiates us in the market. Through responsible AI implementation across operations, engineering, and business functions, we're not just automating processes; we're reimagining what's possible when human creativity partners with artificial intelligence. Our approach centers on measurable business outcomes, ethical governance, and creating capabilities that make every team member more effective while positioning Vantage at the forefront of the intelligent infrastructure revolution.

Position Overview

The Director, AI Platforms leads Vantage’s AI platform strategy and operations, owning the Halo platform roadmap and Vantage’s AI FinOps practice while managing go-to-market packaging, program governance, and cross-team coordination for the entire AI organization. The Director translates the AI strategy set by the Head of AI into the Halo roadmap and delivers it, making Halo, Vantage’s secure, governed AI platform, easy for employees and business builders to access and use, and giving Vantage clear visibility into what its AI consumption costs and where that spend goes. This role owns three interconnected mandates: ensuring platform reliability and continuous improvement, driving enterprise-wide adoption through compelling value narratives, and providing the operational backbone that enables the Navigators and Accelerators teams to execute effectively. The Director builds and leads a team spanning platform engineering, product management, and program operations, creating the infrastructure and governance frameworks that transform individual AI experiments into sustainable enterprise capabilities. Success requires balancing technical platform excellence with business storytelling, operational discipline with innovation agility, and centralized governance with distributed execution. This is the role that ensures Vantage’s AI investments compound rather than fragment, creating shared foundations that accelerate every team’s impact.


Essential Job Functions

  • Build and lead the AI Platforms team spanning Halo platform and roadmap ownership, AI FinOps, go-to-market leadership, and program operations, developing capabilities that balance technical depth with business value communication.
  • Own the Halo platform roadmap at the director level and drive the health, performance, and continuous improvement of Halo, establishing reliability standards, monitoring frameworks, and an onboarding experience that make the platform easy to access and use while ensuring stability and enabling innovation.
  • Run Halo platform management, including support intake, bug triage, documentation and runbooks, and tiered support for the Halo platform and the AI applications built on it, including solutions delivered by the Accelerators team, as well as backlog prioritization, release and change management, and platform health reporting, along with builder onboarding that gets Business-Led Development teams the access, credentials, and development environment they need to start building.
  • Build and lead Vantage’s AI FinOps practice, delivering visibility into metered AI consumption, including Copilot credits, development and operational tokens, and Azure spend, by user, department, and business unit, and partnering with Finance, FP&A, and IT on forecasting, budgeting, optimization, and the showback and chargeback model that prepares business units to own their AI costs in FY28.
  • Drive enterprise-wide platform adoption through compelling value narratives, measurement frameworks, and user engagement strategies that demonstrate ROI and build organizational enthusiasm for AI-powered workflows.
  • Establish and maintain the governance frameworks, reporting structures, and coordination mechanisms that enable the Navigators and Accelerators teams to operate effectively while maintaining organizational alignment.
  • Partner with the Director, Navigators, Global to ensure platform capabilities are well-understood across functional areas, enabling Navigators to identify opportunities that leverage existing infrastructure rather than requiring net-new development.
  • Partner with the Director, AI Delivery, Global to ensure platforms provide stable foundations for rapid prototyping, with clear integration patterns and development standards that accelerate solution delivery.
  • Develop go-to-market strategies for AI capabilities that translate technical features into business value propositions, ensuring every AI solution ships with a clear narrative about why it matters to the organization.
  • Oversee cross-cutting program operations including executive reporting, inter-team coordination, portfolio health tracking, and governance compliance that provide the Head of AI with decision-quality visibility into organizational performance.

Duties

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop platform owners, adoption specialists, GTM leads, and program operations professionals, creating career pathways that retain high performers while building organizational capability.
  • Establish platform health metrics, SLAs, and monitoring dashboards for Halo, ensuring reliability standards are met while identifying opportunities for performance optimization and feature enhancement.
  • Design adoption measurement frameworks that go beyond usage counts to capture meaningful engagement, business impact, and user satisfaction metrics that demonstrate platform value to executive stakeholders.
  • Create go-to-market playbooks that package AI capabilities with compelling narratives, training materials, and support resources that drive organic adoption across the enterprise.
  • Build and maintain the program governance framework including portfolio tracking, resource allocation processes, decision gates, and executive reporting cadences that provide organizational transparency.
  • Facilitate cross-team coordination between Navigators, Platforms, and Accelerators, ensuring information flows smoothly and dependencies are managed without creating bureaucratic overhead.
  • Develop executive reporting packages that synthesize platform health, adoption metrics, delivery velocity, and business value realization into narratives that inform strategic decision-making.
  • Architect platform evolution roadmaps that balance stability with innovation, incorporating feedback from platform users, Navigator discovery insights, and emerging technology capabilities.
  • Improve the Halo builder experience by reducing time to first build, providing self-service access provisioning, and publishing golden paths and templates that remove common blockers such as permissions, credentials, and development toolchain setup.
  • Lead the migration of existing applications into Halo, partnering with application owners and IT to plan, sequence, and support each migration.
  • Build and maintain AI FinOps reporting dashboards and consumption guardrails, including per-user and per-department token and spend telemetry, budget alerts, and forecasts that flag overruns early and provide the reporting evidence required before any consumption reserve is drawn.
  • Establish data governance, security, and compliance standards for platform operations that meet enterprise requirements while enabling the agility needed for rapid experimentation and prototyping.
  • Partner with IT and Security on platform infrastructure, ensuring AI systems meet enterprise architecture standards, cybersecurity requirements, and operational resilience expectations.
  • Monitor competitive landscape and industry trends in enterprise AI platforms, evaluating build versus buy decisions and identifying strategic partnership opportunities that extend platform capabilities.
  • Design and facilitate platform community events, user groups, and feedback channels that build organizational engagement while surfacing improvement opportunities and feature requests.
  • Manage vendor relationships for platform components, negotiating terms that preserve flexibility while ensuring support levels meet enterprise operational requirements.
  • Contribute to AI strategy development by providing platform perspective on organizational capabilities, adoption readiness, and infrastructure investment priorities.
  • Handle additional duties as assigned by Leadership.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications highly desirable.
  • Extensive experience leading platform or product teams in enterprise technology environments, with proven track record building and scaling technology platforms that achieved broad organizational adoption.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise AI and cloud platforms, including Microsoft Azure and large language model (LLM) platforms, with hands-on experience managing platform health and evolution.
  • Experience with FinOps or cloud cost management for consumption-based services, including usage telemetry, forecasting, budgeting, and showback or chargeback models; FinOps Foundation certification a plus.
  • Experience running platform product management practices, including backlog management, bug triage, SLAs, release management, and developer experience for internal builders.
  • Strong product management or go-to-market experience with ability to translate technical capabilities into compelling value propositions that resonate with non-technical business audiences.
  • Demonstrated success building and leading diverse teams spanning technical platform ownership, analytics, product management, and program operations functions.
  • Experience establishing governance frameworks, program management structures, and reporting cadences that provide organizational transparency without creating bureaucratic overhead.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management capabilities with track record building trusted relationships across technical and business leadership in complex matrix organizations.
  • Strong analytical orientation with experience designing metrics frameworks, adoption dashboards, and business value quantification approaches for technology platforms.
  • Understanding of data center operations, infrastructure technology, or related industry contexts that enables credible engagement with business stakeholders about operational challenges.
  • Experience with enterprise AI governance, responsible AI principles, and compliance requirements for AI platform deployment in regulated or mission-critical environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to present to executive leadership, facilitate cross-team coordination, and create compelling narratives about technology platform value.
  • Track record of operating successfully in fast-paced environments where multiple priorities compete for attention and organizational structures evolve continuously.
  • Collaborative leadership style with ability to influence across organizational boundaries, partner with peer directors, and maintain alignment without creating bottlenecks.
  • Travel required is expected to be 15-25% for stakeholder engagement, platform community building, and cross-team coordination.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

About the Role

This REMOTE mid level analyst role will support the newly created No Surprises Act (NSA) actuarial team, with a strong focus on data management, analytics and process ownership. This role will assist in developing actuarial forecasts, reserves, financial analyses, and reporting related to federal NSA activity, while developing a strong understanding of NSA data sources and supporting data quality and reliability. The Actuarial Analyst II will partner across Actuarial, Finance, Operations, Legal, HNS and vendor teams to improve data collection and monitoring processes, assess emerging financial impacts, and communicate key results, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders and senior leadership.

What You'll Do

  • Support the actuarial workstream for NSA, including forecasts, reserve estimates, liability monitoring, profitability analyses, and financial impact assessments.

  • Partner with Actuarial, Finance, Operations, Legal, HNS, and vendor contacts to gather, validate, and interpret data required for NSA financial analysis and reporting.

  • Develop and maintain documentation of NSA data sources, assumptions, methodologies, process flows, and reporting definitions to support consistency and auditability.

  • Create recurring reporting packages that summarize NSA inventory trends, liability movements, payment activity, financial impacts, and notable operational developments.

  • Identify opportunities to improve data quality, streamline data collection, reduce manual effort, and strengthen ongoing monitoring of NSA activity.

  • Integrate NSA inventory, liability, and payment information into actuarial reserving, forecasting, and financial reporting processes.

  • Participate in NSA working sessions and stakeholder meetings to understand operational changes, evaluate financial implications, and provide actuarial perspective on strategic initiatives.

  • Monitor regulatory, operational, and claims-related developments that may affect NSA financial results and communicate findings to actuarial leadership.

Ready for a challenge?


Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.


About this role


We are looking for a Senior Software Developer (Backend) to join our Scheduling Hybrid Network team. If you are passionate about building scalable, resilient distributed systems and thrive in a fast paced, high scale environment, this role is for you.

As a Senior Backend Developer within our Logistics domain, you will play a key role in designing and operating the services that power our courier network. You will own backend systems end-to-end, from data modelling to event flows, deployment, and production operations, and contribute to the architecture of an event driven platform.

Your mission is to deliver robust, performant, and observable backend services, working closely with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to ship features that couriers and the wider logistics platform rely on every day. You will champion modern backend practices, mentor peers, and help shape the future of backend engineering within the organization.

In short, you’ll combine deep backend expertise with a strong engineering mindset to deliver world class distributed services at scale.


Location: Remote - Ontario

Reporting to: Technology Manager


These are some of the key components to the position:


  • Architect and Build scalable, high-performance backend services utilizing Java (Quarkus/Spring Boot) and Node.js architectures.
  • Model and Evolve complex distributed domains using Domain Driven Design (DDD), bounded contexts, and event-driven patterns.
  • Design and Implement robust asynchronous workflows and decoupled communications leveraging Kafka, AWS SQS, and AWS SNS.
  • Own End-to-End Reliability by defining SLIs/SLOs, instrumenting observability via Datadog, and leading production incident response and log analysis.
  • Optimize Data Architecture across relational (Aurora RDS), analytical (Google BigQuery), and caching layers (Redis).
  • Deploy and Operate cloud-native services on AWS/Azure utilizing Kubernetes (EKS) and driving CI/CD and progressive rollouts.
  • Collaborate and Mentor across cross-functional Agile teams (Product, Mobile, QE, Data) to champion engineering excellence and continuous delivery.

What will you bring to the team?


  • Proven Scale Experience: 5+ years of experience building, operating, and tuning production-grade backend services at scale within Agile environments.
  • Advanced JVM & Node Proficiency: Strong, production-proven mastery of Java (Quarkus/Spring Boot); additional backend proficiency in Node.js is highly valued.
  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Deep understanding of pub/sub patterns, idempotency, eventual consistency, and sagas using Kafka, SQS, and SNS.
  • Polyglot Database Mastery: Strong hands-on experience with schema design, query tuning, and migrations across Relational (PostgreSQL/MySQL), NoSQL, and Redis caching.
  • Cloud & Orchestration: Solid production experience deploying to AWS and/or Azure with containerized workloads running on Kubernetes (EKS).
  • Modern DevOps & Testing: Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), GitOps, and rigorous automated testing (K6/Gatling/JMeter).
  • API & Observability Standards: Solid grounding in RESTful API design (with gRPC/GraphQL/AsyncAPI exposure) and comprehensive APM/distributed tracing using Datadog.

AI & Modern Engineering Capabilities


  • AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on experience maximizing productivity using cutting-edge tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Claude Code for software delivery.
  • Agent-Ready Repository Management: Experience structuring codebases for AI contribution by maintaining optimized READMEs, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files, and reproducible local setups.
  • Autonomous Engineering Workflows: Proven experience leveraging AI agents to drive end-to-end tasks, including code generation, complex refactoring, debugging, and automated PR workflows.
  • Workflow Integration & Governance: Experience embedding AI into backend workflows (code reviews, test generation, incident triage) while ensuring reliability, security, and reproducibility.

At JET, this is on the menu:


Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth and about celebrating every aspect of our JETers. Thanks to them we stay one step ahead of the competition.


Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging


No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.


What else is cooking?


Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels

Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now!

About this role:

Reasonable Accommodations Statement

**This role is open to California residents only.**


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Job Function & Responsibilities

  • Configuration Design & Build

o Translate business requirements into accurate HRP configuration across benefits, provider contracts, pricing rules, accumulators, claims edits, and product variations.

o Build and maintain benefit structures, benefit dictionaries, coverage tiers, copays, deductibles, and EOC/Evidence of Coverage mappings.

o Configure provider reimbursement logic including fee schedules, capitation, FFS, value‑based rules, and DOFR constructs.

o Apply HRP tools (HealthRules Language™, Designer/Manager) to model complex logic without custom code.

  • Testing & Validation

o Develop detailed test scenarios and execute UAT for configuration changes, ensuring financial and non‑financial accuracy.

o Perform impact analysis for new configuration, regulatory updates, and system enhancements.

o Support production validation, post‑release monitoring, and defect remediation with clear traceability to requirements.

  • Troubleshooting & Root‑Cause Analysis

o Investigate adjudication issues, benefit discrepancies, and pricing errors using structured analysis.

o Identify root causes across configuration, requirements, provider contracts, and system logic.

o Document findings and collaborate with cross‑functional teams to implement corrective actions.

  • Regulatory & Compliance Alignment

o Ensure configuration adheres to California regulatory requirements, including Medi‑Cal benefit structures, payment rules, and policy updates.

o Maintain awareness of state and federal regulatory changes and assess configuration impacts.

  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration

o Partner with Operations, Network, Product, Compliance, and QA to ensure configuration aligns with business goals and regulatory needs.

o Participate in requirements sessions, benefit design reviews, contract updates, and system enhancement planning.

o Provide subject‑matter expertise during audits, regulatory reviews, and cross‑departmental initiatives.

  • Documentation & Governance

o Maintain clear documentation of configuration decisions, logic, test cases, and validation results.

o Support configuration governance processes, including standards, naming conventions, and version control.

o Contribute to playbooks, SOPs, and best practices for configuration quality and release readiness.

  • Continuous Improvement

o Identify opportunities to streamline configuration processes and reduce defects.

o Support HRP upgrades, parallel testing, cutover readiness, and post‑go‑live stabilization activities.

o Mentor junior analysts and contribute to team knowledge development. Any other duties assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience:

  • High School Graduate or General Education Degree (GED)
  • 2–5 years of hands‑on configuration experience, including at least 2 years working with HRP, across benefits, provider contracts, pricing rules, and claims edits.
  • California health plan experience with strong understanding of state‑specific requirements; Medi‑Cal preferred.
  • Strong understanding of payer operations, claims adjudication, reimbursement methodologies, and regulatory constructs.
  • Proficiency with HRP components such as HealthRules Language™, Designer/Manager (Answers/Connector a plus).
  • Experience with healthcare EDI and code sets (HIPAA 837/835/834/270/271; ICD‑10, HCPCS, CPT, DRG, APC, NDC).
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business requirements into accurate configuration with documented rationale.
  • Strong skills in test planning, UAT execution, impact analysis, and production validation.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote, fast‑paced environment.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

Preferred Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree

  • Three plus years’ experience with Medi-Cal guidelines
  • Three plus years’ experience data analytics and reporting
  • Two years’ experience in a Supervisor, Lead, Trainer, Quality Assurance or Auditor role
  • Three years’ experience using analytical thinking skills and demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment when making decisions
  • Experience with Medi‑Cal managed care contract constructs and operational requirements.
  • Exposure to broader HRP functional areas (enrollment, billing, provider, finance, medical management/GuidingCare).
  • Experience with HRP implementations, conversions, or major upgrade cycles.
  • Familiarity with configuration governance frameworks and release management processes.

Technology & Software Skills: Advanced computer skills in MS Office products.


Certifications & Licenses: None

  • Communication, Oral - Ability to communicate effectively with others using the spoken word.
  • Communication, Written - Ability to communicate in writing clearly and concisely.

K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANY ONE. We provide families with an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.


The mission of Stride is to provide an exemplary individualized and engaging educational experience for students by incorporating school and community/family partnerships coupled with a rigorous curriculum along with a data-driven and student-centered instructional model. Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!


The High School Math Teacher is a highly qualified, state certified educator responsible for delivering specific course content in an online environment. High School Math Teachers provide instruction, support, and guidance, manage the learning process, and focus on students’ individual needs. High School Math Teachers monitor student progress through Stride K12’s learning management system. They actively work closely with students and parents/learning coaches to advance each student’s learning toward established goals. High School Math Teachers typically work from home but must travel occasionally throughout the year to various school functions, such as state testing or as otherwise required by the school.


THIS IS A PART-TIME POSITION THAT WILL LIKELY PAY $20-$25/HOUR

This is a part-time hourly position up to 25 hours per week. Ability to work independently is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday is imperative. Instructional hours fall between 9-5 EST (or 8-4) based on the needs of the schools we serve. Assigned hours may range based on various factors (school need, content area, teacher availability, etc.).


Additionally, the number of assigned hours may be impacted by various factors such as school need, certifications, teacher availability, etc.

Workpay is on a mission to enable companies to hire, manage and pay employees anywhere in Africa legally and compliantly. Whether remote employees in Morocco or a local team in Nigeria, Workpay provides tools to ensure payrolls, compliance, benefits, and payments arrive on time.

Background

At Workpay, we have revolutionized the workforce by integrating Employer of Records (EOR) solutions into our business model. EOR serves as a means of ensuring compliant and efficient employment relationships globally. A simple way to get the best talent in Africa working remotely without the hassle of establishing a local entity. Through collaborating closely with strategic partners, we've established a network that transcends borders. We automate processes and tailor compliance to our clients unique requirements. Now, we're seeking a dynamic individual, preferably based outside Africa, to spearhead partnerships with global EOR organizations. This visionary leader will play a pivotal role in enabling clients worldwide to harness the vast talent pool in Africa, facilitating seamless and reliable remote hiring through our on-the-ground expertise. Join us in redefining global employment dynamics!

Role Overview

The Senior Business Development Executive-EoR will develop and manage strategic partnerships and alliances with organisations that can complement and strengthen our EoR offerings remotely. This role requires a deep understanding of the EOR industry, excellent networking skills, and a track record of successfully nurturing and closing prospects to drive revenue and other growth metrics.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Identify and Evaluate Partnerships: identify potential EOR clients looking to hire remote employees in Africa, assess their compatibility with our services, and evaluate their potential impact on our business.

  2. Inform the go-to-market strategy: create and execute GTM strategies to achieve company goals, including revenue growth, geographic expansion, and service enhancement.

  3. Negotiate Agreements: Lead negotiations with potential clients to establish mutually beneficial agreements, including terms, pricing, and collaboration details.

  4. Relationship Building: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients, acting as the main point of contact and ensuring ongoing collaboration and success.

  5. Market Analysis: Stay updated on market trends, competitors, and industry developments to identify opportunities and competitive advantages.

  6. Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with marketing, legal, and operations teams to ensure seamless implementation and execution of service-level agreements.

  7. Performance Tracking: drive the key performance indicators (KPIs) and track individual performance, providing regular reports and recommendations for improvement to the line manager.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.

  • 3+ years experience in global business development and management, preferably in the Employer of Records or HR outsourcing industry.

  • Strong understanding of global employment regulations and compliance.

  • Exceptional negotiation and communication skills.

  • Strategic thinking and the ability to identify and pursue growth opportunities.

  • Track record of meeting sales revenue targets.

  • Data-driven with the ability to prioritise in a fast-paced organisation and constantly identify the highest-value partners and activities

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Proficiency in CRM software and Google Workspace.

What we offer

  • Working in a flexible, vibrant team environment

  • Constant opportunities for learning and growth

  • Purpose-driven work experience

  • Ownership of your personal development and career advancement

raw.description:
At Guidewell, we are moving from AI experimentation to becoming a genuinely AI-led organization, and that shift requires more than isolated pilots or point solutions. It requires a foundational capability that can keep pace with the frontier of AI while building the platform, infrastructure, and architecture needed to run it safely and reliably at enterprise scale. This role is being created to build, from the ground up, an enterprise capability that can track and apply frontier AI (model evaluation, agentic AI, multimodal AI, human-AI interaction) while establishing the engineering foundation that lets those capabilities scale across a highly regulated healthcare environment.

This is a builder's mandate. You will not inherit a function, you will design it, staff it, and stand it up, reporting directly to the VP of Applied AI Engineering and Platform and working across four interconnected pillars: AI Research & Applied Intelligence, Infrastructure & Platform Engineering, Developer Platform, and Architecture, Strategy & Standards. The person who takes this role will shape how Guidewell builds AI for years to come.

Key Responsibilities:
• AI Research & Applied Intelligence Establish Guidewell's applied AI research function — continuously evaluating frontier developments in model capability, agentic AI, multimodal AI, and human-AI interaction, and translating them into a prioritized roadmap of applied use cases that create measurable value across the health ecosystem.
• Infrastructure & Platform Engineering Build the AI infrastructure and platform capability - compute, MLOps/LLMOps, model pipelines that allows Guidewell to move AI solutions from prototype into reliable, secure, production-grade operation at enterprise scale.
• Developer Platform Stand up a developer platform and toolchain that gives product and engineering teams self-service access to shared AI capabilities, reducing duplicated infrastructure and shortening the path from idea to production.
• Architecture, Strategy & Standards Define Guidewell's AI architecture and engineering standards that lets AI scale safely across a regulated healthcare environment without slowing delivery.
• Strategy & Executive Partnership Partner with the VP of Applied AI Engineering and Platform, and with senior stakeholders across Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Data, Security, Legal/Compliance, and the business, to shape and continuously evolve Guidewell's AI engineering and research strategy.

Key Requirements:
• Related Bachelor’s degree or additional related equivalent work experience

• 7+ years’ related work experience

• 5+ years’ direct supervisory/management experience
• Significant experience leading AI/ML platform, infrastructure, or applied AI engineering organizations at enterprise scale with a track record that includes hands-on architecture work, not just oversight.
• Experience architecting and operating agentic AI platforms in production: orchestration/agent frameworks, tool-access and identity controls, evaluation gates, observability, and deployment pipelines at real scale.
• Deep expertise in a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar) and its infrastructure-as-code, container/serverless, CI/CD, and multi-region resilience practices, with a track record of making that infrastructure both secure and cost-efficient.
• Experience establishing evaluation-first LLMOps practices (regression testing, tracing, human-in-the-loop oversight) for systems that have to hold up under regulatory, clinical, or audit scrutiny.
• Demonstrated experience building and leading engineering organizations from the ground up, including across distributed or global delivery models.
• Strong executive communication and credibility to partner with senior technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred:

• Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-sensitive industry - healthcare, financial services, or similar and translating requirements like HIPAA or SOX into concrete engineering standards.
• Experience redesigning established business or clinical workflows as agent-driven processes, rather than simply automating individual tasks within them.
• Experience building reusable platform components that let product teams assemble AI capability from proven building blocks instead of starting from scratch each time.
• Experience setting technical direction on emerging agentic AI and orchestration techniques as they mature and converting what works into lasting platform standards.
• A background that spans deep hands-on technical architecture and organizational leadership comfortable operating at both altitudes.
• Direct exposure to health plans, providers, clinical operations, or government health care programs.

General Physical Demands

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.

Physical/Environmental Activities

Must be able to travel to multiple locations for work (i.e. travel to attend meetings, events, conferences). Occasionally

What We Offer:
As a Florida Blue employee, you will be at the heart of GuideWell’s vision – to lead the nation in transforming health through compassionate, connected, and technology-enabled care that delivers personalized value and empowered living.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
  • Additional voluntary benefits available; and
  • A comprehensive wellness program

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Typical Annualized Hiring Range: $180,000 - $225,000

Final pay will be determined with consideration of market competitiveness, internal equity, and the job-related knowledge, skills, training, and experience you bring.
