About the role:

A Sr. Principal Analyst uses research and analytical skills to create thought-leading insights that help Sourcing, Procurement and Vendor Management and other IT leaders navigate software and cloud pricing and contracting. As a Gartner analyst, you will meet daily with senior-level clients to help them achieve their most critical priorities, driving performance and business outcomes. To support and build off these conversations, you will research markets, practices and trends as well as publish content and deliver live presentations.

Candidates must have current knowledge of Microsoft’s commercial programs, contracting models, pricing, and discounting approaches as well as a vision for how Microsoft licensing, and overall contracting and negotiations with large vendors, will evolve globally and regionally.

What you’ll do:

  • Provide clients and prospects with compelling, actionable advice regarding their Microsoft pricing and contracting needs, including negotiation strategies and ongoing vendor management, via virtual or face-to-face interactions.
  • Develop and publish innovative, high-impact insights on software pricing and contracting, especially Microsoft, via research articles, webinars, events, and client briefings.
  • Research, analyze, and forecast trends in software, SaaS, and cloud licensing to deliver forward-looking guidance.
  • Lead or participate in ideation and research discussions, collaborating across the BTI community.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis to diagnose client challenges, reframe their strategies, and drive business outcomes.
  • Be client-centric while also encouraging clients to engage regularly with Gartner.
  • Proactively work with the wider sales organization and deliver outstanding sales support to retain and grow the business.
  • Provide high quality and timely peer review and feedback. Drive team success by mentoring and supporting team members.
  • Represent Gartner’s insights and methodologies with credibility in client engagements and media interactions.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that drive team success.

What you’ll need:

Gartner analysts are viewed as the experts. This means you need to know your markets, vendors, trends, management practices, etc. and be able to see the forest and the trees. You should have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred.
  • 8+ years’ experience with a minimum of 5 years work experience in SaaS/software contract negotiations, technology procurement, category management, vendor management or software asset management within a buying organization, outsourcer, consulting firm, or reseller.
  • Extensive, recent, hands-on experience negotiating with Microsoft (within last 12 months).
  • Subject matter expertise in Microsoft licensing with understanding of the negotiation process, software and cloud services market trends, the global landscape, and reseller ecosystem.
  • Experience with software license compliance risk assessment, management, and/or mitigation in a software audit context, particularly with Microsoft, is desired.
  • Experience with other major vendors (e.g., AWS, Google, Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, or ServiceNow) is desired.
  • Executive presence with the ability to quickly establish credibility with senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills, with comfort delivering engaging presentations to diverse audiences. Able to clearly and concisely articular complex concepts, engage clients and respond effectively to questions.
  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data. Can effectively identify and apply patterns, concepts, and frameworks while defending from client challenges.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to produce high-quality deliverables under tight deadlines.
  • Self-motivated, collaborative, quick-learning, and comfortable working in a multicultural, matrixed environment.
  • Able to conduct occasional travel (usually no more than 25%), regionally and globally.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

Job Description:

Job Summary

The Customs Brokerage Representative III is responsible for performing advanced customs brokerage functions to facilitate the timely and compliant clearance of imported shipments. This position reviews and audits import documentation, classifies merchandise using the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS), supports Participating Government Agency (PGA) requirements, and ensures compliance with U.S. Customs and other government regulations. The role requires strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to resolve documentation discrepancies, support customers, and maintain operational excellence throughout the customs clearance process.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and submit customs entries accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Monitor and follow up on the customs clearance process for all assigned entries.
  • Review, audit, and validate commercial documentation to ensure compliance with customs regulations and customer requirements.
  • Classify merchandise using the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) to support accurate duty assessment and regulatory compliance.
  • Coordinate freight movement and delivery to designated locations.
  • Communicate documentation discrepancies and clearance issues to customers, supervisors, carriers, and other stakeholders.
  • Interface with international and domestic carriers, overseas offices, importers, and government agencies to facilitate shipment processing.
  • Resolve finance, billing, and accounting reconciliation issues related to customs transactions.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and scan records into company imaging systems while meeting established deadlines.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and analyses using various software applications and databases.
  • Research, troubleshoot, and resolve entry processing and documentation issues.
  • Communicate effectively with customers and foreign origins through verbal and written correspondence.
  • Establish and maintain positive customer relationships while providing a high level of service.
  • Conduct internal audits and provide findings and recommendations to management.
  • Support weekend and holiday coverage on a rotational basis as required by operational and account needs.
  • Perform general customs brokerage, administrative, and data entry functions as assigned.

Qualifications

Required

  • High school diploma, GED, or international equivalent.
  • Knowledge of customs operations, customs laws and regulations, and government agency requirements.
  • Basic understanding of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classification system.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • Accurate and efficient data entry skills.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Must be located within 50 miles of Dallas, TX.

Preferred

  • 1+ years of experience working for a Customs Broker or within a customs import brokerage environment.

raw.description:
About the game

Hopetown is a new narrative-first RPG inspired by Disco Elysium, being built by some of the team that worked on Disco Elysium, including Martin Luiga (founder of the ZA/UM Cultural Movement, writer of several characters on Disco Elysium, writer of the first short story in the Disco Elysium world), Lenval Brown (narrator of Disco Elysium) and Piotr Sobolewski (former CEO of Knights of U, which completed all the tech for Disco Elysium).

We are currently moving into early production, building out the foundational systems, characters, and mechanics that will define the experience. With your help, we can transform Hopetown from a great cRPG into an unforgettable one — a living, breathing universe of stories, surprises, and challenges.

About us

Longdue is a studio founded to create rich, emotional, story-first games that challenge players’ expectations. We’re a remote team of writers, artists, designers, and engineers, bringing together talent from across the industry to push the boundaries of narrative-driven RPGs.

We are still early in production, meaning new team members will have a real, tangible impact on the world we are building. We believe that extraordinary games can come from small, focused teams that value creativity, openness, and care over convention.

About the role

We’re looking for a Lead Narrative Designer with both creative and production instincts — someone who can shape Hopetown’s story while helping to build the systems and structures that make great narrative work possible.
You’ll lead a small team of writers through the early stages of development, balancing storytelling vision with clear planning, coordination, and delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with design, production, and tech to align narrative goals with development milestones and to ensure the narrative team’s output fits smoothly into the broader pipeline.
This role sits at the intersection of creativity and operations — ideal for someone who loves story but also thrives on clarity, structure, and collaboration.

Add to What You’ll Be Doing:

  • We’re looking for a Narrative Lead with both creative and production instincts, someone who can shepherd Hopetown’s story while helping us refine systems and structures that make great narrative work possible.
  • You’ll lead a small team of writers, balancing storytelling vision with clear planning, coordination, and delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with design, production, and tech to align narrative goals with development milestones and to ensure the narrative team’s output fits smoothly into the broader pipeline.
  • This role sits at the intersection of creativity and operations, ideal for someone who loves story but also thrives on clarity, structure, and collaboration.

Requirements

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years of experience leading and/or managing a narrative team on a narrative-first game, ideally in the RPG space.
  • Proven ability to plan, organise, and deliver narrative work within production milestones, experience coordinating pipelines, tracking progress, and aligning with design or production teams
  • Proven experience writing emotionally resonant, character-driven stories
  • Experience overseeing multiple writers’ work and overseeing edits to ensure cohesion in both tone and style
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Basic understanding of other disciplines and how their work integrates with narrative and design.
  • Familiarity with production and project management tools (e.g. Basecamp, YouTrack, or similar)

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience shipping or contributing to a narrative-driven RPG title, especially within a small or startup-style team
  • Strong familiarity with Disco Elysium-like, dialogue-heavy storytelling structures
  • A creative and adaptable mindset suited to an early-stage, highly collaborative studio environment
  • A love for narrative experimentation, psychology, and surreal or philosophical themes

Benefits

WHY JOIN US

Creative Freedom: We foster an environment where your unique voice and vision can shape a groundbreaking RPG.

Thought-Provoking Project: Help create a game that challenges conventions, offers a deep philosophical experience, and invites players to explore not only a mysterious world but also the depths of the human psyche.

Flexible Working: We are a remote-first studio, offering you the freedom to work from wherever inspiration strikes.

raw.description:
About us

At Longdue, we’re dedicated to crafting narrative-first, psychologically deep, RPGs.

We focus on creating games with real depth—whether in our characters, environments or the stories we tell. We’re here to challenge your choices, your morality—everything you think you know. We’re here to make games where decisions matter and have consequences. We want to build on the legacy of classic story-driven RPGs while reviving the genre meaningfully.

Our goal is simple: to become a trusted name in the greater RPG canon.

With talent from the original Disco Elysium team and veterans from the wider industry, including Bungie and Rockstar, we’re creating something new—a project that resonates, challenges, and leaves a lasting mark.

We’re Longdue, and we’re finally here.

The role

We are seeking a talented Writer to help craft an immersive, multi-layered RPG experience for our computer RPG in its early stages. The gameplay will focus on dialogue choices, character interactions, and a branching story where every decision has consequences. You’ll be responsible for creating narrative content that combines psychological depth, philosophical musings, and a richly evocative world that brings player choices to life.

Responsibilities

  • Write compelling dialogue and narrative events that deepen the connection between characters and the world.
  • Develop a rich story that explores the interplay between the physical environment and the protagonist’s mental journey.
  • Contribute to building a universe awash in contrasts, where environments from two interconnected worlds reflect each other in direct and mysterious ways.
  • Collaborate with designers, artists, programmers, and your colleagues in narrative to ensure the story is deeply integrated with gameplay, emphasising role-play and skill-based checks inspired by TTRPG mechanics.

Requirements

Must-have

  • Proven experience in writing for video games, especially RPGs or interactive fiction. Creative writing or screenwriting experience is also highly valued.
  • Ability to craft a story that explores themes of psychogeography, human psychology, and the dark corners of society. We want characters and dialogue that are multifaceted, flawed, and profoundly human.
  • Ability to develop environments that reflect the character’s internal state, exploring connections between space, mood, and psychology.
  • An interest in delving into cosmic mysteries, existential questions, and philosophical ideas about society, power, and individual purpose.
  • Capable of working within a creative team, taking feedback constructively, and contributing to the shared vision of the project.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with narrative-heavy RPGs.
  • Experience in crafting non-combat gameplay loops that revolve around storytelling, exploration, and character development.
  • Knowledge of TTRPG-inspired mechanics such as dialogue reels, dice-based checks, or psychological skill systems.
  • Experience writing in media other than video games.

Benefits

Creative freedom: We foster an environment where your unique voice and vision can shape a groundbreaking RPG.

Thought-provoking project: Help create a game that challenges conventions, offers a deep philosophical experience, and invites players to explore not only a mysterious world but also the depths of the human psyche.

Flexible working: We are a remote-first studio, offering you the freedom to work from wherever inspiration strikes.

Join Us: We’re here to make narrative-first, psychologically deep RPGs. If you’re passionate about storytelling, design, and pushing the boundaries of what games can be, Longdue is the place for you.

Hunter is looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our fully remote team. This role is about using email, social, channel, and paid to help users reach their a-ha moment in the product, increase usage, and generate revenue.

You’ll be the go-to person for all things lifecycle, owning the strategy and execution of this critical area.

You’ll report to the Head of Marketing, and work alongside a cross-departmental team: Ana (Account Manager), Antonio, Chris (Design), Gio (Head of Customer Success), Istvan (Design), Jeanro, Matt (CEO), Rui (Product Manager), and Ziemek.

Requirements

At Hunter, Marketing is a corepart of how we generate brand affinity and revenue.

Hunter sits in a highly-competitive category with increasing noise, but thanks to its lineage as a first mover in 2015, it is an established, trusted brand.

In this role, you'll cut through that noise, joining a team of enthusiastic, highly-skilled marketers who take pride in their role as a caretaker of the brand. The touch points that we have with our users, as a trusted voice in a sea-of-sameness, are critical to growing the loyalty that millions of users have with Hunter.

Your goal is to own the entire lifecycle of our users so that more eyeballs see Hunter, more users find, verify, and send emails using the platform, API, and MCP server, and our brand continues to be the trusted voice in this category.

How marketing works at Hunter

Hunter's marketing has grown from SEO foundations. Over the last two years, more activity in research, content, email marketing, paid media, and affiliates have contributed to incredible growth.

Your task is to work on the onboarding and nurture engine that engages our users to promote our content, convert free users to paid plans, and increase the lifetime value of our users.

In this role, you need deep knowledge of this category, user empathy, and the stakeholder & project management skills to work with the Head of Marketing, Head of Customer Success, Product Manager, and our marketing team to deliver growth measured in free>paid conversion rate, lifetime value, and retention.

You'll walk into an established onboarding and nurture engine, dozens of campaigns, and co-marketing opportunities, and immediately hit the ground running, firstly by reviewing and creating rapid improvements to onboarding and nurturing, before turning your attention to planning and executing critical Q1 campaigns.

Ownership areas include:

  • Email marketing (onboarding, nurturing, retention, win-back, newsletters, and promotional)
  • Cold email marketing
  • Co-marketing with partners
  • Affiliate marketing campaigns
  • Social media
  • Written and video content creation (inc. blogs and webinars)
  • Reporting and insights

What you’ll do:

  • Own the user journey: You'll work cross-department to own the full user journey - from search and account creation, through to converting to a paid plan, increasing usage, and limiting churn - leveraging the full channel mix to engage, educate, and nurture users.
  • Increase free-to-paid conversions: Your core measurement is the ability to convert free user to a paid plan.
  • Establish and improve the nurture engine: You'll build a nurture engine that leverages user-behavior and persona signals to deliver personalized communications that builds brand affinity.

  • Sales enablement: You'll identify users who might need help getting started, maximizing their plan, or with multiple users from their account and proactively engage them to support sales pipeline generation.
  • Channel marketing: You'll manage communications with our affiliate program and support co-marketing activities to engage new partners.
  • Agentic marketing support: You'll proactively develop, own, and continuously improve the use of AI in your workflow using Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini.

About you:

  • You have at least 5 years experience with a lifecycle marketing role, with proven success in building onboarding and nurturing that contributes to sales pipeline, won revenue, and retention in a PLG model.
  • You have deep empathy of our users and not only understand, but plan around the B2B buying cycle, creating timely, helpful, and motivating communication to our users as they go through their year and all it brings.
  • You take full ownership of the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of lifecycle marketing across the full channel mix, including email, cold email, ads, social, affiliates, and partners.
  • You are highly proficient at managing different projects, processes, and stakeholders (internal and external) to maintain control, communication, and success.
  • You have a curiosity to learn about, and connect challenges to messaging that engages, educates, and motivates increased product usage and brand affinity.
  • You are tech-savvy and a self-starter. we’ll train you on our system and tools, but you should generally be comfortable with technology, including customer.io, a CMS (like Wordpress), Canva, Claude, Planable, Posthog, Linear, and Notion.
  • You are data-driven (quantitative and qualitatively) and use an analytical mind to plan, execute, and experiment on campaigns and conversion rate optimization, employing small-bets to identify growth loops to invest further.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills, and integrate these skills into AI workflows.
  • You’re experienced in remote work and feel comfortable working independently, primarily through async communication.

Time zone & work hours

Support Services Technician I (Tier 1) – PEAKE Technology Partners
About the Role
PEAKE Technology Partners is seeking a motivated and service-driven Support Services Technician I to serve as the first point of contact for our clients, primarily healthcare organizations across the United States.
In this role, you will operate within a structured, SLA-driven Managed Services environment, delivering timely, high-quality technical support while ensuring exceptional client experience. You will be responsible for resolving common IT issues, maintaining accurate documentation, and contributing to a predictable, high-performing service desk operation.
This is an ideal role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values accountability, and is passionate about delivering reliable, client-focused support.
What You’ll Do
  • Provide front-line technical support via phone, email, portal, and remote tools within defined SLA targets
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to desktops, laptops, printers, mobile devices, and core business applications related to Health Care systems
  • Accurately log, categorize, and document all service requests in ConnectWise
  • Perform common service desk tasks including account provisioning, password resets, and access management
  • Diagnose issues efficiently and drive resolution or escalation based on priority and impact
  • Adhere to defined SLA response and resolution targets based on ticket priority (P1–P4)
  • Maintain clear, professional, and empathetic communication with clients throughout the ticket lifecycle
  • Escalate complex or high-impact issues to Tier 2 or specialized teams as appropriate
  • Contribute knowledge base articles and support knowledge-centered service practices
  • Follow up on tickets to ensure full resolution and a positive customer experience
  • Support adherence to HIPAA, security, and compliance standards in all interactions
What Makes Someone Successful at PEAKE
At PEAKE, success is defined by both performance and alignment to our core values:
  • Competence – You take ownership of your work, continuously improve your technical skills, and deliver high-quality outcomes
  • Persistence – You remain solution-focused, work through challenges, and follow issues through to resolution
  • Supportiveness – You communicate with empathy, build trust with clients, and contribute to a collaborative team environment
You also thrive in a metric-driven environment, where performance is measured, tracked, and improved over time.
Qualifications
  • High school diploma required, Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in IT or related field preferred
  • 6+ months of IT support experience (service desk or help desk environment preferred) (MSP highly preferred)
  • Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Microsoft 365 environments
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, VPN)
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and technical aptitude
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Customer-service mindset with patience, professionalism, and accountability
  • Familiarity with ITSM/ITIL concepts and ticketing systems (preferred)
  • Ability to work within structured processes and meet performance expectations
Preferred (Not Required) Certifications
  • CompTIA A+
  • CompTIA Network+
  • CompTIA Security+
  • Microsoft Fundamentals (MS-900, AZ-900, etc.)
  • ITIL Foundation
How We Measure Success
Performance in this role is measured through key service desk metrics aligned to PEAKE’s operational standards, including:
  • SLA Response and Resolution Compliance (target ≥95%)
  • First Contact Resolution (FCR) rate (target 70–85%)
  • Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) by priority
  • Ticket quality and documentation accuracy
  • Ticket volume and productivity (tickets closed per day)
  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT ≥ 90%)
  • Low ticket re-opened and escalation rates
Success in this role means delivering fast, accurate, and professional support while contributing to a stable, scalable, and high-performing service desk.
Why PEAKE
At PEAKE, you’ll be part of a team focused on building a modern, scalable MSP support organization that prioritizes:
  • Predictable service delivery
  • Continuous improvement
  • Strong team culture
  • Exceptional client experience

raw.description:
About the Team/Role:

As the Lead Designer for Digital Experience Standards at WEX Inc., you will set and hold the bar for experience quality across our digital portfolio and codify it through scalable platforms. Reporting to the Director of Digital Platforms & Practice, you are a senior individual contributor accountable for how our products look, sound, and feel as more of the experience is generated by agents rather than assembled by hand.


This is a “tastemaker” role. We define taste as the ability to draw from deep customer empathy, consider your product’s brand tone, voice, and identity, and channel them into an end-to-end experience that is consistent, recognizable, seamless, and delightful. As AI collapses the cost of producing an interface, taste becomes the constraint that matters—and the difference between a portfolio that feels intentional and one that merely functions.


This role sits within WEX’s centralized digital standards and practices group. While design teams are aligned to individual product lines, this position connects that work through shared standards, design systems, and AI-enabled practices. You will influence quality across dozens of web and mobile experiences, partner with the branding team, and coach designers rather than own a single product’s roadmap.


If you hold strong opinions about craft, have an instinct for what customers feel but do not say, and can encode that judgment so other people—and agents—apply it at scale, this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do:

  • Set Experience Standards & Taste: Define what “good” looks like across the portfolio and encode it as standards, patterns, and reference examples that any designer or agent can apply without you in the room.
  • Make Coherence Scalable: Build a system in which experiences feel recognizably WEX in brand, tone, voice, and interaction regardless of which team or agent produced them.
  • Lead Portfolio-Level Critique: Lead critique and calibration that builds judgment in other designers and raises craft rather than policing it.
  • Anticipate Emerging Modalities: Bring a point of view on voice, conversational, and multimodal interaction so standards anticipate how customers will work rather than how they have worked.
  • Own the Design OS for the Agentic Lifecycle: Own the reusable components, skills, standards, and machine-readable context that agents invoke to generate consistent UI in ADLC Foundations Hub and Discovery & Delivery Systems.
  • Translate Design Intent into Build-Ready Artifacts: Partner with the design system engineer to create tokens, patterns, schemas, and documentation that both humans and agents can consume.
  • Make Quality the Default: Make the standard the path of least resistance, so generated experiences inherit accessibility, usability, and brand quality by default rather than by review.
  • Use AI-Assisted Coding and Prototyping: Use modern AI-assisted coding and prototyping tools to explore concepts, test interactions, and operationalize repeatable design guidance. Tools discussed for this role include Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex.
  • Define Experience Quality Measurement: Establish an enterprise experience quality rubric with dimensions, criteria, and severity scales for usability, accessibility, brand and voice coherence, language clarity, and end-to-end journey quality.
  • Build Agentic Evaluation at Scale: Develop evaluation capabilities that allow agents to navigate live customer portals, mobile apps, and internal tools across full journeys and return evidence-backed findings.
  • Make Quality Visible to Leadership: Produce a portfolio-level experience quality index and heat map showing strengths, weaknesses, and specific quality dimensions across lines of business.
  • Connect Quality to Business Outcomes: Correlate experience quality with NPS, CSAT, and customer trust measures, and use those signals to direct standards, coaching, and investment toward experiences where customer risk is highest.
  • Partner and Influence Across Teams: Work with product designers, engineering, and the branding team to unify experiences across WEX’s digital portfolio and raise the quality and polish of web and mobile products.
  • Coach Without Direct People Management: Coach and mentor designers across product teams, bringing exceptional visual/UI design taste and attention to detail while maintaining a collaborative, outcome-focused approach.

What You Bring:

  • Design Experience: Approximately 8–10 years of product, system, web, or related design experience across multiple products or portfolios.
  • Exceptional Visual/UI Craft: Demonstrated visual design taste, artistic judgment, strong attention to detail, and a high bar for polish and aesthetics across digital experiences.
  • Standards and Systems Thinking: Ability to define, document, and scale design standards, patterns, and systems that improve consistency and quality across teams and products.
  • AI-Native Design Practice: Strong fluency with AI coding and prototyping tools, including tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex, and the ability to use them practically in design workflows.
  • Machine-Readable Design Guidance: Understanding of how to express design standards and context in reusable, structured formats such as Design MD/design.md so people and AI agents can apply them consistently.
  • Customer-Centered Judgment: Deep customer empathy and the ability to translate customer needs, brand identity, tone, voice, and interaction principles into cohesive end-to-end experiences.
  • Collaboration and Influence: Low-ego, collaborative, and outcome-focused approach with the ability to influence designers and cross-functional partners without relying on direct authority.

Nice to Have:

  • Background in graphic design, web design, human factors, or another related artistic or design discipline.
  • Experience coaching or mentoring designers across multiple product teams or portfolios.
  • Familiarity with general-purpose AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini; this is useful but does not replace practical fluency with AI coding and prototyping tools.
  • UX boot camp experience.

Why This Role Matters:

WEX is working to unify the quality of digital experiences across business lines while expanding the use of AI in how those experiences are designed and built. This role will help shape the standards, systems, and evaluation practices that make high-quality, accessible, recognizable WEX experiences repeatable across dozens of web and mobile products. By turning design judgment into reusable guidance for both people and agents, the role helps WEX scale experience quality without relying on manual review alone.

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.Pay Range: $154,600.00 - $171,500.00

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn du dich in den nachfolgenden Punkten wiederfindest.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Du hast genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen du nicht wirklich profitierst? Dann solltest du einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung zwischen 52.000€ und 85.000€ / Jahr
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf 100% Homeoffice
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Fort- und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen und ein persönlicher Mentor
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient deinen Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an dich, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. Deine Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

Job Description

First American Bank was founded in Chicago, and over the years has expanded throughout Wisconsin and Florida. As the largest privately held bank in Illinois, we now have over 60 locations and assets of $8+ billion. We are a community bank at heart with international expertise, traditional values, and a forward-looking philosophy. Our employees have the experience and vision to meet the needs of savers, borrowers, and businesses in the 21st century. First American Bank can offer employees a level of visibility, career growth, and stability that is difficult to find in many larger corporations.

The Debit Card Dispute Specialist hourly (non-exempt) position investigates and resolves debit card and Zelle disputes by researching and monitoring cases to ensure Regulation E compliance, reviewing chargeback statuses, and handling unposted cardholder items. Additionally, this position monitors a variety of reports and performs general research tasks related to debit card operations.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITES

  • Investigate and resolve debit card disputes by researching and monitoring cases while ensuring Regulation E compliance is met. Review reports for chargeback statuses. Research cardholder unposted items and prepare checks as needed.

  • Comply with REG E, MasterCard rules, Network rules, and internal policies and procedures.

  • Process Zelle dispute claims. Ensure claims are processed according to all policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

  • Prepare the MasterCard Billing Reports (MCB).

  • Prepare end-of-the-month status reports.

  • Monitor the Account Data Compromise alerts. Warm cards that were reissued due to the alerts.

  • Perform general research tasks related to debit card operations as needed.

  • Conduct and complete additional assignments/projects as designated by management.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum one year of experience in banking or bank-related field required.
  • Previous experience in debit/credit card operations and balancing/account reconciliation preferred.
  • Must be professional, comfortable speaking with external and internal contacts with a demonstrated ability to tailor the message appropriately to the audience and situation effectively.
  • Demonstrated ability to convey thoughts and ideas effectively and succinctly via written formats, including emails, letters, and electronic platforms. Maintain professional standards relating to spelling and grammar.
  • Maintain credibility through professional demeanor, appearance, and presence by modeling standards appropriate to our environment and industry.
  • Maintain good working relationships with internal partners by exhibiting exemplary interpersonal skills, adopting a constructive, solutions-focused approach.
  • Use sound professional judgment to balance the interests of the organization and customer, understanding and using available resources to mitigate risks.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 products and applications, including the ability to effectively prepare or review documents, procedures, and reports.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new systems and applications, as well as the ability to understand, adapt and adjust responsibilities/workflows as a result of system upgrades.
  • Occasional travel to other First American Bank locations, Bank functions, and training facilities may be required.
  • Typical schedule is Monday through Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Additional hours may be required depending upon business need.
  • Punctuality is required to maintain First American Bank’s customer service standards.

raw.description:
Job Title:

Senior Principle, Transportation Optimization

Job Description:

Position Summary

The Senior Principle, Transportation Optimization is responsible for developing and executing the enterprise transportation strategy to improve service, cost efficiency, visibility, scalability, and network performance across domestic and global operations. This role leads the design and optimization of transportation networks, operating models, technology platforms, analytics capabilities, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the overall effectiveness of the transportation ecosystem.


The position is accountable for evaluating, selecting, and implementing transportation operating models, including:

  • Control Tower
  • Fourth-Party Logistics (4PL)
  • Managed Service Provider (MSP)
  • Hybrid solutions

This leader will conduct outsource versus insource assessments, develop business cases, oversee provider selection and implementation, and establish governance frameworks to ensure sustainable value realization.


Working closely with Global Transportation and cross-functional stakeholders, the Senior Principle, Transportation Optimization focuses on the strategic design, transformation, and continuous improvement of transportation capabilities. Responsibility for day-to-day transportation execution, carrier relationship management, performance escalation, transportation procurement execution, and carrier negotiations remains with the Global Transportation organization.


Key Responsibilities:


Transportation Strategy & Network Optimization

  • Develop and execute enterprise transportation optimization strategies aligned with company growth, customer service, and profitability objectives.
  • Lead transportation network design and optimization initiatives across domestic and international operations.
  • Develop cost-to-serve models and transportation network scenarios that support strategic decision making.
  • Evaluate mode strategy, transportation flows, network capacity, service requirements, and resiliency opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve transportation cost, service performance, visibility, and scalability.
  • Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving transportation practices.

Transportation Operating Model Design

  • Evaluate and recommend transportation operating models, including internally managed, Control Tower, 4PL, MSP, and hybrid solutions.
  • Lead outsource versus insource assessments for transportation planning, execution, analytics, visibility, and support functions.
  • Develop financial models, organizational impact assessments, and business cases supporting transportation transformation initiatives.
  • Design governance structures, metrics, service requirements, and accountability frameworks.
  • Establish operating processes and performance expectations for transportation service providers.
  • Ensure selected operating models deliver measurable service, productivity, and financial benefits.

Strategic Provider Selection & Governance

  • Evaluate Control Tower, 4PL, MSP, visibility, and technology partners.
  • Establish governance models and executive review processes for strategic transportation technology partners.
  • Partner with Procurement and Legal on commercial terms and contractual requirements.
  • Measure implementation success and value realization against approved business cases.

Transportation Technology & Visibility

  • Own the transportation technology strategy and roadmap.
  • Lead selection and implementation of TMS, Control Tower, visibility, optimization, freight audit & payment, and analytics platforms.
  • Develop end-to-end transportation visibility capabilities supporting proactive decision making.
  • Partner with IT to drive automation, integration, and modernization initiatives.
  • Leverage advanced analytics and digital solutions to improve transportation performance.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop transportation KPI frameworks and executive dashboards.
  • Utilize analytics to identify opportunities for service improvement and cost reduction.
  • Lead Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct scenario modeling and strategic assessments supporting network decisions.
  • Measure and report realized benefits from optimization initiatives.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with Operations, Customer Logistics, Planning, Procurement, Finance, and IT.
  • Lead enterprise transportation transformation initiatives.
  • Present recommendations, business cases, and strategic plans to senior leadership as part of strategic long-range planning cycles.
  • Drive adoption of new transportation processes, systems, and operating models.
  • Support organizational capability development and change management efforts.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain strategy, network design, distribution, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience leading transportation optimization and transformation initiatives.
  • Experience evaluating and implementing Control Tower, 4PL, MSP, and transportation technology solutions.
  • Strong analytical, financial modeling, and business case development skills.
  • Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence executive stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Logistics, or Business Administration.
  • APICS/ASCM CSCP, CPIM, CLTD, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent professional certifications.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide optimization, transformation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Experience operating within complex, multi-site, global supply chain networks.

Compensation: The pay range for this role is: $170,000-$220,000/yr with pay commensurate upon the candidate's experience.

Member of Technical Staff - Full Stack

Austin, TX | Remote (US) | Full-time

About the Role

Join Suppli as a Backend Engineer and help rebuild payments for the >$1tn distribution industry. You’ll architect and build the systems that process millions of dollars in transactions daily, integrate with complex ERP systems, and leverage cutting-edge LLM technology to transform how distributors manage their revenue cycles.

You’ll join a small team of A+ players where everyone acts as an individual contributor while actively supporting each other through pair programming and collaborative problem-solving. You’ll work closely with our founder-led team who previously operated a distribution business and understand the real-world problems we’re solving.

Who Thrives Here (read this first — it saves everyone time)

  • AI-Native: You already use Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar every single day. You treat AI as a pair programmer, not a toy or a threat.

  • Product-minded: You obsess over the “why” behind features, dig into customer data (or talk to customers), and measure success in revenue and user love — not story points.

  • Ownership > tasks: You hate being blocked. When something is unclear or broken, you prototype, reach out directly, pair, or just ship a pragmatic solution.

  • Builder mentality: Strong opinions, weakly held. You default to shipping the simplest thing that works (often with AI help), then iterate fast.

What You’ll Own

  • High-volume payment processing systems and secure financial APIs

  • Deep integrations with major ERPs (NetSuite, Sage, Acumatica, etc.)

  • LLM-powered workflows (credit decisions, remittance matching, automated comms)

  • Real-time data pipelines handling millions of financial records

  • AR / collections automation that directly impacts customer cash flow

Must-Have

  • 5+ years of backend experience with strong system design chops

  • Expert-level Ruby on Rails (Rails 7+, Ruby 3+) — our core backend is modern Rails and you’ll own huge parts of it from day one → Exceptional candidates with deep experience in Django, Laravel, Spring Boot, or similar who are excited to go all-in on Rails will be considered

  • Advanced PostgreSQL (query optimization, large datasets, logical replication, etc.)

  • Proven ability to design clean, versioned REST/JSON APIs

  • Experience shipping and operating ETL/background-job heavy systems in production

Bonus Points

  • Built or maintained third-party integrations with enterprise software

  • Real fintech, payments, or billing experience (Stripe, ACH, lockbox, etc.)

  • Hands-on LLM integration or prompt engineering (bonus if you’ve shipped it to production)

  • Previously worked at a Series A–C startup and loved the chaos

Tech Stack (today — evolves fast)

  • Backend: Rails 7+, PostgreSQL, Sidekiq, Redis

  • Infra: AWS, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD

  • AI: OpenAI / Anthropic APIs, vector DBs, Cursor/Claude daily

  • Security: Bank-grade encryption, SOC 2 in progress

Engineering Culture

True end-to-end ownership — no PMs writing pixel-perfect specs. We pair program (human + AI), ship daily, write tests that matter, and refactor mercilessly. AI tools are first-class citizens here: we expect you to 10× your output with them and help us push the boundaries of what’s possible in fintech automation.

Benefits

  • 🌴 Flexible paid time off so you can recharge.

  • 🏋️ Up to $100/mo wellness reimbursements.

  • 🖥️ Up to $500/year home office stipend

  • 📈 A competitive stock option grant, so you have skin in the game.

  • ⚕️Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with 100% of premiums paid by us.

  • 📍Quarterly team gatherings for periodic in-person collaborative strategy and work sessions.

  • 👫 A passionate, supportive team dedicated to learning and growing together.

Responsibilities

SafeGuard Services (SGS), a subsidiary of Peraton, performs data analysis, investigation, and medical review to detect, prevent, deter, reduce, and make referrals to recover fraud, waste, and abuse.

What you'll do:

This position is on the SGS NE UPIC contract supporting Medicaid initiatives across the northeastern jurisdiction. The northeastern jurisdiction includes the following states:

Maine, Vermont, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, and the District of Columbia.

This individual’s primary responsibilities are to research, understand, and articulate Federal and State regulations and policy as they relate to the administration of the State Medicaid programs for those states within the northeastern jurisdiction. As the subject matter expert, the position will work to gain an understanding of these programs and their respective nuances by state and work with the greater Medicaid team to primarily research and educate in tandem with project development or in response to referrals.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Articulate policy/regulations in both a written manner and through discussion/presentation.
  • Provide a written policy contribution for incorporation into the Analytical Findings Report.
  • Consult to identify projects in collaboration with the Project Coordination team and the Data team.
  • Identify potential program vulnerabilities arising out of policy research.
  • Interact with the states in the jurisdiction to engage in policy discussion.
  • Interact with CMS to engage in policy discussion.
  • Keep abreast of emerging issues and developments that have direct impact on the state Medicaid programs within the jurisdiction.
  • Assist the Medicaid Operations Lead with special research projects as requested.
  • Ownership of the Medicaid Policies & Procedures Manual to include an annual review to determine if direction is current, which may include needed updates as well as ad hoc updates as direction changes (i.e., internally or by the customer).
  • Track policy workload and report monthly to the Medicaid Operations Lead.
  • Oversee state meeting agendas and minutes process in coordination with the Business Analyst.
  • Position will be Telework available from all states and time zone(s).

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • 5 years with BS/BA or 9 years with a HS Diploma
  • At least 5 years’ experience in policy research and analysis.
  • Ability to present and discuss state policies and regulations in connection with project impact.
  • Ability to research policies, interpret regulations and regulatory rules/guidance.
  • Strong interpersonal skills: ability to work and make decisions independently and in a team environment.
  • Excellent planning, organizational skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communications; able to communicate and make presentation to all levels of management and associates at all levels throughout the Company.
  • Must be able to meet established deadlines and handle multiple customer service demands from internal and external customers, within set expectations for service excellence.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, self-motivated and energetic qualities desirable.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Outlook).
  • US citizenship required

The most competitive candidates will have:

  • Experience with CMS programs – Medicaid and Medicare.
  • Experience with Managed Care programs.
  • Knowledge of CMS regulations related to State Medicaid programs to include waivers.
  • Knowledge of CMS 64 – analyse and interpret reports to determine trends and vulnerabilities.
  • Knowledge of Federal Matched Assistance Program to State Medicaid programs.
  • Medical Coding knowledge/experience related to billing of Medicare/Medicaid claims a plus.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

$66,000 - $106,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

raw.excerpt: Company OverviewTessolve offers a unique combination of pre-silicon and post-silicon expertise to provide end-to-end solutions in VLSI Design, Test & Product Engineering, and Embedded Systems.
raw.description:
Company Overview

Tessolve offers a unique combination of pre-silicon and post-silicon expertise to provide end-to-end solutions in VLSI Design, Test & Product Engineering, and Embedded Systems. We work with leading semiconductor companies worldwide, enabling innovation through deep domain knowledge and engineering excellence.

Summary of the Role

We are looking for skilled and motivated Design for Test (DFT) Engineers with 4–10 years of experience in developing and implementing advanced DFT methodologies for complex SoCs and ASICs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement DFT architectures for SoC/ASIC designs.
  • Utilize expertise in Scan Insertion, ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, JTAG, and Boundary Scan.
  • Work on tool flows for Synopsys/Mentor/Cadence DFT tools.
  • Collaborate with RTL, physical design, verification, and test teams to integrate and validate DFT features.
  • Debug and resolve issues during synthesis, simulation, and silicon bring-up.
  • Deliver high-quality test coverage while optimizing for area, power, and performance impact.
  • Support ATE patterns generation and silicon validation.

Required Qualifications

  • Must-Have:
  • Strong knowledge of DFT methodologies (Scan, ATPG, BIST, Boundary Scan, JTAG, compression techniques).
  • Hands-on experience with industry-standard DFT EDA tools (Synopsys DFTMAX/TetraMAX, Cadence Modus, Mentor Tessent).
  • Good understanding of RTL design, logic synthesis, timing, and verification.
  • Solid debugging and problem-solving skills across pre-silicon and post-silicon phases.
  • Experience in handling complex SoC/ASIC designs with multi-million gates.
  • Scripting skills (Perl, Python, Tcl, Shell) for automation.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Nice-to-Have:
  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Electronics/Electrical/Computer Engineering or related field.
  • Exposure to low-power DFT techniques and advanced nodes (7nm/5nm/3nm).
  • Experience in ATE test bring-up and production test support.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement plan with employer matching.
  • Paid time off and holiday leave.
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

Additional Information

  • This position is part of the engineering department, and the successful candidate will report to the DFT Engineering Manager.
  • Openings available for this role: 1.

Role Overview:

Could you be our next Scrum Master III? Globe Life is looking for a Scrum Master III to join the team!


In this role, you will be responsible for coaching multiple Scrum teams, facilitating Agile ceremonies, and improving sprint planning and delivery processes to help teams consistently deliver value. You will guide teams in adopting Agile principles and practices, remove obstacles that impact progress, and collaborate with Product Managers, stakeholders, and organizational leaders to strengthen team performance and support continuous improvement.


This is a remote / work-from-home position.


What You Will Do:


  • Manage and support multiple Scrum teams simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination, alignment, and consistent Agile practices.
  • Launch new Scrum teams and coach established teams to adopt and advance Agile and Scrum practices.
  • Provide advanced coaching to Scrum teams, Product Managers, and organizational leadership to strengthen Agile understanding, team maturity, and organizational agility.
  • Lead sprint planning and forecasting activities across multiple teams, supporting realistic commitments, accurate capacity planning, and alignment on priorities.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to support effective collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Identify and remove impediments, monitor risks and dependencies, and proactively address challenges that could impact sprint delivery.
  • Establish, track, and analyze Agile performance metrics, including velocity, burn-down and burn-up charts, cycle time, and throughput, to improve forecasting and support data-driven decisions.
  • Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to align team deliverables with business objectives and customer value.
  • Support Agile Release Train (ART) launches and cross-functional planning to improve coordination and delivery across teams.
  • Promote a culture of transparency, accountability, and collaboration while serving as a change agent for Agile practices and organizational improvement.

What You Can Bring:


  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • A Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Advanced Certified Scrum Master certification, or a Release Train Engineer (RTE) certification.
  • Five to seven years of experience working on IT project teams, including at least two years as a Scrum Master.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies, frameworks, and practices, including Scrum and Kanban.
  • Experience serving as a Release Train Engineer (RTE), including launching Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
  • Ability to proactively identify cross-functional risks, dependencies, and challenges while supporting effective planning and delivery.
  • Strong coaching and facilitation skills, with the ability to guide teams through Agile adoption and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to present complex information clearly and confidently to technical teams, IT professionals, and diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to coach teams that are new to Agile, Scrum, or Kanban frameworks.
  • A Product Owner or Product Manager certification is preferred.

Applicable To All Employees of Globe Life Family of Companies:

  • Ability to work full time and/or part time based on the position specifications.

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are looking for a QA Tester to join our LabArchives team working on our industry-leading Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN), Inventory, and Scheduler products. You will work cross-functionally with technology, product, and support teams, you will have a substantial impact on our development process and, of course, our products.

LabArchives is a secure, cloud-based platform for collaborative research data management and lab course publishing. Researchers, instructors, and students use it to organize, document, store, protect, share, and publish their research and data. Our products are trusted by hundreds of thousands of researchers, thousands of lab science courses and instructors, and hundreds of institutions, pharmaceutical companies, and other organizations around the globe.

We want a technology enthusiast who thrives on close collaboration with colleagues across several departments, and who brings a passion for quality and customer delight to all of our systems and processes as we grow LabArchives globally.

In this role you will get to

  • Contribute to the full lifecycle of test case design, planning, execution, and scaling.
  • Help create and expand our automation test framework.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to ensure quality is built into every product and thoroughly tracked.
  • Continuously inspect and improve our quality processes to deliver world-class products and make everyone around you better.

We are looking for people who with a relevant Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of education and 2+ years of relevant working experience.

The Key Skills we are looking for:

  • Exposure to functional test plan design, documentation, and execution for both new feature development and regression of legacy systems
  • Ability to clearly document and communicate software defect details, reproduction steps, and execution context
  • Basic knowledge of software QA methodologies and tools

In addition to base salary, Dotmatics has implemented a total rewards strategy, which is the combination of compensation, benefits and recognition.

Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

  • Wellness Benefits (Mental Health Apps and Fitness Perks)
  • Company-paid Life and Disability Insurance
  • 401k Retirement Plan (with 4% company match; immediate vesting)

$61,000—$83,000 USD

raw.description:
Please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

Location: Remote (U.S. based; must be available to work PST/MST hours)

Background Check Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017 by landscape ecologist and fire mitigation expert Harry Statter, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We’re building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

About This Opportunity

As a Senior Accountant at Frontline, you will be the person who keeps the general ledger in order - not as a task-completer, but as someone who cares about the integrity of what the numbers say. Frontline runs three revenue models simultaneously: milestone-based construction installations, bill-and-hold hardware product sales, and recurring software subscriptions. Underneath that, we have multi-entity operations, complex balance sheet activity, and a business that's scaling fast. The work is detailed, intellectually demanding, and consequential.

Reporting to the Controller, you will own bank and credit card reconciliations, balance sheet reconciliations, intercompany reconciliations, and the day-to-day accuracy of our general ledger. This is a role for someone who is not just comfortable with that level of precision - but who finds genuine satisfaction in it. If you like to solve puzzles, enjoy the feeling of every account tying out cleanly, and take pride in a ledger that's airtight, this is your seat.

Key Responsibilities

General Ledger & Reconciliations

  • Own bank and credit card reconciliations across all company accounts, ensuring every transaction is accurately recorded, categorized, and resolved in a timely manner.
  • Prepare and review monthly balance sheet reconciliations - accounts payable, accounts receivable, accruals, prepaids, intercompany, and other balance sheet accounts - with full supporting documentation.
  • Maintain the general ledger with a high degree of accuracy, posting journal entries and ensuring the ledger reflects the true financial position of the company at all times.
  • Investigate and resolve reconciling items promptly; track open items and follow through to resolution rather than leaving discrepancies unaddressed.

Month-End Close

  • Execute assigned close tasks within the month-end close schedule, including journal entries, account tie-outs, and flux analysis on key balance sheet and P&L accounts.
  • Prepare clear, organized work papers and reconciliation packages that can withstand audit scrutiny.
  • Partner with the Controller to identify opportunities to tighten the close timeline without sacrificing accuracy.

Accounts Payable & Receivable Support

  • Support AP and AR functions as needed, including vendor coding, payment processing, customer invoicing, and collections activity.
  • Ensure transactions are coded to the correct entity, department, and account, particularly as the company expands across multiple states and operating entities.

Compliance & Audit Readiness

  • Maintain documentation and internal controls that support audit readiness at all times.
  • Support external auditors and tax advisors by preparing schedules, reconciliations, and requested documentation.
  • Assist with multi-state sales and use tax compliance and payroll tax filings in coordination with the Controller.

Process Improvement

  • Identify inefficiencies in reconciliation and close workflows and propose improvements that increase accuracy and reduce manual effort.
  • Support the evaluation and adoption of accounting tools and automation that streamline transactional accounting functions.

Qualifications

Must-Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 4+ years of accounting experience, with a strong foundation in general ledger accounting
  • Extensive, hands-on experience with bank reconciliations, credit card reconciliations, and balance sheet reconciliations - this is the core of the role
  • Deep familiarity with the general ledger: how it works, how entries flow, and how to identify and resolve errors
  • Detail-oriented and precise - someone who notices discrepancies, digs into them, and doesn't move on until accounts are clean
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Excel/Google Sheets
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Nice-to-Have

  • CPA license or active CPA candidacy
  • Experience in a startup, high-growth, or multi-entity environment
  • Familiarity with construction accounting, including job costing and WIP schedules
  • Experience with accounting tools such as QuickBooks Payroll, Avalara, LiveFlow, or Sage Intacct
  • Exposure to ERP systems such as NetSuite, Acumatica, or Intacct
  • Experience supporting an external audit or preparing audit schedules
  • Background in climate tech, construction, hardware, or SaaS business models

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary: $95,000 - $115,000 DOE
  • Company-provided cell phone and laptop
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible time off + 14 paid holidays (yes, your birthday is one of them!)
  • Work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup
  • Remote-first work environment, fostering work-life balance and autonomy
  • Company-provided equipment
  • Join a high-performing, mission-driven team doing work that truly matters
  • And much more!

Join Our Mission!

If you're excited about building technology that protects homes and families from wildfire disasters, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of a fast-growing team with purpose and innovation at its core.

Diversity and inclusion are essential values at Frontline. We know we'll do our best and most impactful work when we feel represented, and we belong. We encourage talented people from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

  • Respond promptly and professionally to internal and external customers and discern when to appropriately escalate
