raw.excerpt: About CleerlyWe’re Cleerly – a healthcare company that’s revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked.
raw.description:
About Cleerly

We’re Cleerly – a healthcare company that’s revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world’s leading cardiologists and are a growing team. Most of our teams work remotely and have access to our offices in Denver, Colorado, New, York, New York, Dallas, Texas, and Lisbon, Portugal with some roles requiring you to be on-site in a location.

Cleerly has created a new standard of care for heart disease through value-based, AI-driven precision diagnostic solutions with the goal of helping prevent heart attacks. Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly’s solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world’s largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person’s risk of heart attacks.

At Cleerly, we collaborate digitally and use a wide variety of systems. Our people use Google Workspace (GMail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides), Slack, Confluence/Jira, and Zoom Video, prior experience in these areas is a plus. Role or department specific technology needs may vary and will be listed as requirements in the job description.

While we are mostly a remote company, travel is required for some team meetings and cross function projects typically once per month or once per quarter, for some roles like sales or external facing roles travel could be up to 90% of the time.
Cleerly is committed to providing safe and effective medical software that meets customer needs and our intended use. The adherence to all applicable regulatory and statutory requirements establishes a clear framework for setting measurable quality objectives. Our commitment to continually improving our products and processes proactively manages risks, ensuring ongoing compliance throughout the entire software lifecycle. Understanding this role's relevance and importance is critical to achieving Cleerly's quality objectives.

About the Opportunity

As a Senior Product Designer, you will employ your mature kit of human centered design methods to facilitate alignment of stakeholders to solutions that meet real user needs. While you might do some wireframing and interaction design, you are just as much of a user researcher, an insights synthesizer, a problem framer, a sensemaker, a journey mapper, an information architect, and a usability engineer. You are someone who takes initiative, drives your design process, and doesn't wait for internal Product Management or Engineering partners to tell you what is needed. In this role, you act as an alignment facilitator, leveraging a unique set of tools and skills to guide the team toward delivering user-centered solutions aligned with our mission to transform the standard of cardiac care and eliminate heart attacks worldwide.

About the Team

Cleerly's leadership in cardiovascular care innovation offers significant opportunities for passionate and mission-driven individuals. You will join a high-performing Product Design function that is valued and supported by executive leadership. We are committed to driving measurable impact across our products with a focus on improving customer delight, increasing adoption, and ensuring scalability.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Product Design: Lead the entire design lifecycle, driving projects from discovery through launch, managing deadlines, and facilitating stakeholder alignment.
  • Outcome-Driven Accountability: Directly drive a quantifiable reduction in operational friction by designing highly efficient, scalable, and error-minimized workflow solutions.
  • Design Craft & System Stewardship: Apply superior information architecture, interaction, and visual design craft to all deliverables. Actively contribute to and leverage Cleerly’s design system to accelerate product realization and elevate the quality baseline.
  • Feasible Design Delivery: Serve as a core partner to Engineering and QA, understanding technical constraints and ensuring that delivered designs are viable for efficient implementation.
  • Strategic Influence & Thought Leadership: Serve as thought partner to Product Management, Engineering, and Clinical teams, actively providing informed design perspectives and driving strategic cross-functional decisions.
  • Evidence-Based Optimization: Conduct deep discovery-type user research, defining audiences and mapping workflows, to identify friction points and opportunities for improvements within complex multi-user workflows.
  • Risk-Based Design: Perform regulatory-compliant human factors engineering activities such as task analysis, use-related risk analysis, risk-based formative usability evaluations, and actively contribute to the cross-functional risk management efforts.
  • Design Advocacy & Communication: Employ outstanding communication and storytelling skills to distill complex workflow issues into clear, engaging narratives, actively amplifying the voice and business impact of design company-wide.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 8+ years of professional experience in Product Design with a strong portfolio and case studies demonstrating expertise in complex B2B, analytics, and dashboarding solutions.
  • Comfortable working in afast-paced, innovative startup environment where changes are frequent, maintaining a positive attitude toward ambiguity.
  • Proven ability totackle complex products from start to finish with high autonomy, demonstrating a track record of driving and measuring quantifiable improvements in business and user outcomes.

Additional Requirements

  • Expert proficiency with Figma’s advanced features and familiarity with AI-powered user research tools for qualitative (e.g. Dovetail) and quantitative research.
  • Experience with rapid prototyping leveraging design systems and AI (Figma Make, Figma MCP Server, Lovable, 3Cursor, etc).
  • Experience in the HealthTech, SaMD, or other domains with complex data and specialized workflows.
  • Experience designing applications involving medical imaging or large-scale scientific data.

The base salary range for this role varies by location and is aligned to market benchmarks.

  • Candidates located in higher-cost labor markets, including California, Washington, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Massachusetts, and Washington, DC represent the middle to high end of the range, while candidates located in all other U.S. locations represent the low to middle end of the range.
  • Final compensation is determined based on location, experience, skills, and internal equity.

This role is eligible for a 15% target annual bonus, resulting in the following base salary and Total Target Compensation (TTC) ranges:

  • Base Salary: $166,950 - $192,180

*Total Target Compensation (TTC): Total Cash Compensation (including base pay, variable pay, commission, bonuses, etc.) Additionally, stock options, paid benefits, and employee perks are part of your total rewards.

Working at Cleerly takes HEART. Discover our Core Values:

  • H: Humility- be a servant leader
  • E: Excellence- deliver world-changing results
  • A: Accountability- do what you say; expect the same from others
  • R: Remarkable- inspire & innovate with impact
  • T: Teamwork- together we win

Don’t meet 100 percent of the qualifications? Apply anyway and help us diversify our candidate pool and workforce. We value experience, whether gained formally or informally on the job or through other experiences. Job duties, activities and responsibilities are subject to change by our company.

OUR COMPANY IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. raw.description:
Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day.

Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead.

At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end - step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves.

We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them.

Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast

Job Description:

Darktrace is building a world-class team of Specialist field experts with the ambition of becoming the world's leading AI-powered cybersecurity company. As organizations rapidly adopt generative AI, copilots, autonomous agents, and AI-driven business processes, Darktrace is uniquely positioned to help customers secure what AI can do, thanks to our 13 years’ experience of using AI for cyber security.


This high-profile, customer-facing role will support sales teams around the world, based on US East Coast, helping strategic customers adopt and secure AI technologies through Darktrace's Behavioral Defense Platform and Darktrace / SECURE AI portfolio. The role combines deep technical expertise, executive engagement, and business leadership to accelerate revenue growth, influence product direction, and establish Darktrace as the market leader in AI security.


As a Global Blackbelt, AI Security Specialist, you will serve as a trusted advisor to customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, helping organizations safely deploy AI at scale while maintaining visibility, governance, and control over AI systems, agents, and data flows.


You will work alongside account teams, product management, marketing, engineering, and executive leadership to drive some of Darktrace's largest and most strategic AI security opportunities.


Please note: To be considered for this opportunity, candidates must be located within the Eastern (ET) or Central (CT) time zones.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with account teams and regional leadership to develop AI security strategies that support revenue growth, customer retention, and platform expansion.
  • Serve as a senior technical authority for strategic AI security opportunities across enterprise, cloud, SaaS, hybrid, and operational technology environments.
  • Lead executive briefings, support customer workshops, technical evaluations, and Proof of Value engagements focused on AI security outcomes.
  • Mentor field pre/post sales engineers and account teams on AI security technologies, competitive positioning, and customer engagement strategies.
  • Advise customers on securing GenAI platforms, AI copilots, AI agents, AI development environments, and emerging autonomous workflows.
  • Demonstrate and position Darktrace / SECURE AI capabilities, including Shadow AI discovery, AI prompt analysis, AI agent identity security, and AI development management – alongside the overall Darktrace Behavioural AI Platform.
  • Help customers build governance, visibility, and security controls around the rapidly expanding use of AI across their business.
  • Develop trusted relationships with CISOs, CIOs, AI leaders, security architects, and executive stakeholders.
  • Identify expansion opportunities across Darktrace's broader platform, including Network, Email, Cloud, Endpoint, Identity, OT, and AI Security solutions.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to provide customer feedback, competitive intelligence, feature requests, and roadmap influence.
  • Support the development of repeatable AI security sales motions, technical enablement programs, and customer success frameworks.
  • Create and present thought leadership content including webinars, whitepapers, conference presentations, blogs, and industry research.
  • Represent Darktrace at customer executive events, analyst briefings, industry conferences, and AI security forums.
  • Develop and maintain strategic partnershipwith hyperscalers, AI platform providers, cloud providers, SASE vendors, MSSPs, and consulting partners.

Skills & Experience

Required

  • Proven experience as a Security Strategist, Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager, or similar customer-facing technical role. Experience on the customer-side would also be highly valuable, alongside excellent presentation and communication skills.
  • Strong expertise in cybersecurity, cloud security, AI security, data security, or cyber risk management.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting consultative and solution-based sales through technical leadership and subject matter expertise.
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills with the ability to simplify complex AI and cybersecurity concepts.
  • Experience building trusted relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence and lead outcomes across highly matrixed organizations.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise security architectures including cloud, identity, networking, endpoint, email, and SaaS environments.
  • Experience with common AI platforms and ecosystems such as Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and other emerging AI technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of AI risks including but not limited to prompt injection, data leakage, excessive permissions, agent abuse, model misuse, supply-chain risks, and Shadow AI.
  • Familiarity with AI governance, AI risk management, and emerging AI security frameworks.
  • Experience discussing AI adoption strategies with executive stakeholders and security leadership teams.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience deploying or securing enterprise AI, machine learning, or generative AI solutions.
  • Experience in cybersecurity domains such as NDR, XDR, SIEM, EDR, cloud security, identity security, email security, or security operations.
  • Knowledge of AI security frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI RMF, AISF-1, MITRE ATLAS, ISO 42001, and related industry guidance.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Security, AWS, Google Cloud, OpenAI, Anthropic, CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler or similar technology ecosystems.
  • Experience influencing product direction through customer feedback, competitive analysis, or market insights.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, Azure Security Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, Microsoft Security certifications, CompTIA SecAI+ or equivalent.
  • Experience working in fast-growth cybersecurity or SaaS organizations.

Benefits:

  • 100% medical, dental and vision insurance, plus dependents

  • Paid parental leave

  • Pet insurance Discount

  • Life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401(k)

  • Employee Assistance Program

As a growing business strengthening its governance and controls, this role plays a part in supporting high standards of integrity and accountability.

Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

The Senior Counsel, AI & Legal Technology serves as a senior legal advisor supporting Relativity on all matters relating to AI, product development, and legal technology. This role reports directly to the General Counsel.

Job Description and Requirements

Primary Objectives:

  • Serve as the go-to legal advisor for issues relating to AI, product development, and marketing.
  • Monitor, interpret, and communicate developments in AI law and regulation (domestic and international) as well as industry trends — translating complexity into actionable guidance.
  • Develop internal policies, frameworks, agreement terms and best practices that enable the business to move quickly and in compliance with applicable and emerging laws.
  • Develop and advise on industry relationships, and negotiate terms with independent software vendors, open source providers, strategic partners, and go-to-market collaborations.
  • Review and advise on AI-specific terms in customer and vendor agreements and customer-facing materials,
  • Advise on product development, feature launches, and go-to-market strategies, recommending practical and defensible approaches.

Secondary Objective:

Partner cross-functionally with Engineering/Applied Science, Product, Partner, Customer Success, Strategy, Procurement, and other business stakeholders to enable growth, manage legal risk, develop scalable processes, and support strategic initiatives. Support the Partner team on collaboration agreements, co-marketing arrangements, and alliance structures with legal technology partners and AI vendors.

  • Assist business stakeholders with legal review of marketing activities, joint initiatives, and external-facing technology collaborations.

Welcome to a different kind of legal team.

We don't slow business down — we help it move forward. This is a team of legal professionals who are as invested in outcomes as the business teams we support. We're looking for an attorney who thrives at the intersection of law and business — someone who picks up a pen to find a path forward using their legal expertise, not to put up a roadblock. You draft and negotiate with confidence, you're energized by complexity, and you bring solutions to the table before anyone has to ask. The ideal candidate moves fast without losing the thread, leads with strategy while staying in the weeds when it matters, and influences stakeholders well beyond the legal lane. You know how to turn ambiguity into clarity, surface issues early, and come ready with answers. You treat process improvement as a competitive advantage and approach every challenge with a positive, collaborative instinct. If you're a critical thinker with a genuine love for the craft of legal work, this is your team.

This is a pivotal, new role, with room to grow as the company, the industry, and the regulatory environment evolve.

Role Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead legal representative for enterprise AI, product development, marketing and legal technology. You will be a senior, visible voice — not buried in a large legal department. Your opinions will shape company strategy.
  • You are a jack-of-all-trades when it comes to understanding, and being able to address, legal and compliance questions in company products and business operations, and with respect to the vendor products and services that are critical components of company business operations and customer solutions.
  • Be a reliable and trusted advisor to our internal stakeholders by providing creative, strategic legal advice and business counsel on commercial, operational and strategic legal issues, as well as providing timely and accurate responses. Identify the issues, and then solve for them.
  • Engage with our customers – make sure they feel listened to and heard, and above all, deliver.
  • Work directly with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Partner, and Strategy teams — not just other lawyers.
  • Suggest and work on improvements in processes, e.g. new standard approaches to beta testing, or variations in product documentation and contract language to enhance efficiency and align to business and product requirements.
  • Exhibit agility and enjoyment working with AI legal technology tools by thriving on the efficiency they create. Know how to identify which ones work for what purposes, and why, and be willing and flexible about trying out new ones.
  • Skilled knowledge working with AI tools (including legal technology tools), Microsoft O365, Salesforce and Ironclad.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Six (6) or more years of relevant experience in-house and/or at a law firm supporting technology initiatives, which might include experience with intellectual property, M&A, technology transactions, privacy, and data. Meaningful exposure to AI, data, and technology legal issues
  • Experience with software development, open source licensing issues, including OSI-approved license compliance, OEM licensing; computer technology; familiarity with developer and marketplace agreements, including API terms, SaaS agreements, and platform policies.
  • Background in marketing law, including knowledge of FTC and applicable state laws.
  • Strong understanding of technology, including legal technology, cloud services, software licensing models, open source, information security, privacy, intellectual property, and regulatory considerations.
  • Experience supporting AI-enabled products, legal technology, and emerging technology issues.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communicator who can explain complex legal concepts to non-lawyers without oversimplifying.
  • Intelligence, flexibility, creativity, diligence, resourcefulness, responsiveness, and strong communications skills.
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset — you identify risk and propose a path forward, not a stop sign
  • Required: Deep, demonstrable knowledge of the AI regulatory landscape, including emerging U.S. and international frameworks (EU AI Act, EU omnibus, state-level AI bills, FTC guidance, etc.).
  • Desirable but not required: Basic knowledge of intellectual property and proprietary rights issues including data, trade secrets and trademarks.
  • Desirable but not required: Experience advising product and marketing teams in a fast-paced technology or legal technology company.
  • JD degree from an accredited law school and license to practice in the United States
  • Ability to research and analyze legal issues
  • Solid proficiency with AI tools, legal technology tools, MS Office and legal research platforms and tools. Familiarity with Salesforce, Ironclad and Asana.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Juris Doctor from an accredited law school.
  • Active bar membership in good standing
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Intelligence, flexibility, creativity, diligence, responsiveness, and strong communications skills.
  • Strong exposure to computer and software technology concepts.
  • Solid proficiency with MS Office, Salesforce, and Contract Management Software

Suggested Skills:

Business Law, Commercial Laws, Drafting Documents, Government Affairs, Healthcare Law, Labor and Employment Law, Legal Consulting, Legal Documents, Litigation, Securities Laws

Knowable is the world leader in post signature contract management, helping enterprises easily understand the opportunities and commitments in tens or hundreds of thousands of legal contracts. This role translates complex legal reasoning into structured, production-ready LLM workflows that support contract intelligence at scale. You will work closely with legal subject matter experts, product managers, engineers, and data scientists to design AI-driven solutions that analyze contractual language, deliver reliable outputs, and create meaningful customer value. The position combines deep contract expertise with hands-on application ofAI technologies in real-world legal workflows.

  • Demonstrated fluency with AI and LLM tools, including prompt design, structured outputs, grounding strategies, and model evaluation.

  • Experience deploying LLM-powered workflows into production environments.

  • Prior experience with contract analytics or contract intelligence platforms.

  • Deep expertise in commercial contract analysis, including vendor agreements, procurement contracts, NDAs, and amendments.

  • Ability to assess legal equivalence, materiality, and risk implications across clause variations.

raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Front End Developer with strong Oracle Application Express (APEX) expertise to support the design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of web-based applications within a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This position will focus on developing intuitive, responsive, accessible, and maintainable user interfaces using Oracle APEX, while working closely with backend developers, database specialists, UX/design personnel, product owners, and other members of the development team. The ideal candidate is an experienced front-end developer who has significant hands-on experience developing applications in Oracle APEX, rather than simply supporting or administering existing APEX applications. The developer should be comfortable extending APEX using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS and working with SQL, PL/SQL, REST APIs, and Oracle database-driven applications.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Front End Developer – Oracle APEX will:Oracle APEX Development
  • Design, develop, enhance, test, and maintain web applications using Oracle Application Express (APEX).
  • Develop and configure APEX pages, regions, forms, reports, interactive grids, navigation components, shared components, and other user-interface elements.
  • Use APEX Page Designer, Dynamic Actions, validations, computations, processes, and shared components to implement application functionality.
  • Develop responsive and user-friendly application interfaces using APEX capabilities combined with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Customize APEX templates, themes, and page components to meet application and user-experience requirements.
  • Develop reusable APEX components and common UI patterns to improve consistency across applications.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve APEX application issues involving page processing, session state, validations, dynamic actions, navigation, and application behavior.
  • Support the modernization and enhancement of existing Oracle APEX applications.
  • Participate in application releases, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production support.
Front End Development
  • Develop responsive, accessible, and intuitive web interfaces.
  • Create and maintain front-end functionality using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, and Oracle APEX.
  • Translate functional requirements, wireframes, and designs into working application interfaces.
  • Improve usability, navigation, page layout, forms, workflows, and other interactive application components.
  • Ensure interfaces function consistently across supported browsers, devices, and screen sizes.
  • Identify and correct front-end defects, display problems, validation issues, and usability concerns.
  • Work with UX and content personnel to implement application interfaces that provide a consistent user experience.
  • Participate in peer reviews and contribute to front-end development standards and reusable design patterns.
Application & Integration Development
  • Work with backend developers and database specialists to integrate the APEX front end with application data and business logic.
  • Develop and maintain SQL and PL/SQL necessary to support APEX application functionality.
  • Create and consume RESTful APIs and web services to integrate APEX applications with other enterprise systems.
  • Troubleshoot issues involving application interfaces, data retrieval, REST integrations, authentication, and application processing.
  • Work with technical teams to diagnose issues that span the user interface, APEX application layer, APIs, and Oracle database.
  • Support secure data exchange and application integration requirements.
  • Participate in integration testing and validation of application functionality.
Accessibility & User Experience
  • Develop applications with accessibility and usability incorporated throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Support Section 508 accessibility requirements applicable to federal digital services.
  • Implement accessible forms, navigation, controls, error messages, and interactive components.
  • Work with QA and accessibility personnel to identify and remediate user-interface defects.
  • Incorporate feedback from users, product owners, and UX personnel to continuously improve application usability.
Development & Project Support
  • Participate in requirements analysis, design discussions, development, testing, deployment, and application support.
  • Work closely with product owners, Operations Managers, developers, database administrators, testers, UX personnel, and government stakeholders.
  • Estimate development activities and communicate technical risks, dependencies, and constraints.
  • Document application functionality, technical solutions, configurations, and development decisions.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing activities, defect resolution, and release preparation.
  • Support Agile development activities and collaborate with team members to meet sprint and release objectives.
  • Troubleshoot production application issues and support root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement
  • Must hold or be able to maintain Secret clearance.
Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Web Development, or a related technical discipline preferred.
  • Relevant professional development experience may be considered in place of a degree when permitted by contract requirements.
Experience
  • 3–5 years of professional front-end, web, or application development experience.
  • Strong hands-on Oracle APEX development experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience building and enhancing applications using Oracle APEX rather than solely administering or supporting APEX environments.
  • Experience developing responsive web interfaces using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience developing application functionality using Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
  • Experience troubleshooting web applications across the UI, application, integration, and data layers.
  • Experience working as part of a cross-functional software development team.
  • Federal government or DoD application development experience preferred.
Technical KnowledgeRequired
  • Strong proficiency with Oracle Application Express (APEX).
  • Hands-on experience with APEX Page Designer, Dynamic Actions, Shared Components, forms, reports, Interactive Reports, and Interactive Grids.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
  • Experience developing responsive web-based application interfaces.
  • Experience consuming or integrating RESTful APIs/web services.
  • Understanding of relational databases and data-driven application development.
  • Experience debugging and troubleshooting application and front-end problems.
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, including requirements, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
Preferred
  • Experience with Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS).
  • Experience implementing authentication, authorization, application roles, and access controls within APEX.
  • Experience customizing APEX Universal Theme, templates, and reusable UI components.
  • Experience with application performance troubleshooting and optimization.
  • Familiarity with Git or other source/version-control systems.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum development teams.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD concepts and automated application deployment.
  • Familiarity with Section 508/WCAG accessibility requirements.
  • Experience developing applications within secure federal or DoD environments.
Skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
  • Strong front-end development and user-interface design skills.
  • Ability to translate business and functional requirements into effective application interfaces.
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues across the front end, APEX application layer, integrations, and database.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and application usability.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, database administrators, UX specialists, testers, product owners, and government stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple development activities and priorities in an Agile delivery environment.
  • Ability to document technical solutions clearly and maintain development documentation.

As a ServiceNow Developer Sr Principal, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of our customers. You will play a crucial role via the following:


  • Architect and automate enterprise IT Asset Management (ITAM) and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) capabilities

Align platform architecture with the Common Service Data Model (CSDM). Maintain CMDB health by configuring Data Certification, Discovery, Reconciliation, and Health Assessments.

  • Demonstrated experience with full-cycle SAM and/or HAM implementations
  • Deep understanding of software licensing metrics and physical hardware asset lifecycles from procurement to disposal
  • Experience in ServiceNow platform architecture, Flow Designer, and Integration Hub
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, AngularJS, JSON, and REST/SOAP web services
  • Experience with ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, and Performance Analytic

  • Ability to analyze requirements, troubleshoot issues, and develop effective technical solutions
  • Excellent understanding of the Agile software testing process and lifecycle, from smoke test to integration to production deployment
  • Ability to identify, understand, document, and create functionality aligning with customer value streams
  • Ability to produce level of estimates and basic deployment plans for ServiceNow functionality
  • Strong organizational and time management skills while working in a rapid software development environment
  • Ability to identify and learn new technologies quickly
  • Excellent communication skills for collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills
  • Ability to coach, guide, and mentor junior developers

Leidos is seeking a Senior Proposal Managerto lead and manage the development of winning proposals for the US Navy SMIT contract. The proposal manager is responsible for overseeing the entire proposal process from start to finish, ensuring that all proposals are completed on time, adhere to client requirements, and align with strategic objectives.

A successful candidate must thrive in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment while maintaining attention to detail and driving organization and structure throughout cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate will be interested in cross-training to be able to understand and support all aspects of proposal development including researching past performance, writing proposal sections, and supporting oral presentations.

This position supports telework.

Primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead and manage the overall proposal development process from Pre-Proposal through Post Proposal (negotiations) and award or cancellation.
  • Interpret technical and management requirements of SMIT solicitations (e.g., RFPs, RTEPs, RFIs) and contract modifications.
  • Support a variety of proposal types based on Federal Acquisition Rules for Cost Plus, Fixed Price, and Time and Material, as well as a variety of requirement types from staff support, NON-IT, to Complex IT/Network/Cyber.
  • In collaboration with Contracts and Program Managers support contract Task Order Modifications.
  • Maintain and log activity in for each assigned proposal in SalesForce, providing twice weekly updates including at least one on Friday.
  • In collaboration with SMIT Program Managers, create and oversee schedules, outlines, compliance matrices, proposal kickoffs, pricing strategies, Gate reviews and technical solution sessions.
  • Plan for and arrange resources such as proposal review teams, editing, graphics support, and desktop publishing.
  • As required - develop the business model for invoices and grouping of work elements.
  • As required - review and if necessary develop basis of estimate documentation to support proposals.
  • Facilitate proposal reviews (e.g., Initial Draft, Red Team) and oversee adjudication and tracking of reviewer comments.
  • Coordinate with management teams, functional units, Business Development personnel, stakeholders, partners, and subject matter experts to provide leadership, support, and guide overall direction of proposal development.
  • As required, edit proposals to ensure clarity of proposal solution and presentation.

As a Sr. Operations Program Manager, you'll join our team remotely to support the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS). Work visa sponsorship will not be provided for this role.


At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As a Sr. Operations Program Manager supporting CMS, you will be trusted to manage project schedules and tasks for operations team members, manage work assignments to project and contract scope, and build and maintain client trust. You will need to demonstrate a Consultant Mindset, understanding the bigger picture, breaking down complex problems to design actionable solutions, drive user adoption and champion continuous improvement, and build trust, managing expectations and leading with credibility. In this client-facing role, a typical day will include:

  • Ensuring accurate and timely updates to project schedules and reporting for milestones, project progress, and other operational metrics.
  • Attending or facilitating client meetings to identify business needs and provide recommendations for approaches to solving challenges with operations techniques.
  • Overseeing the delivery of reports, dashboards and insights that analyze key operations and performance metrics.
  • Overseeing the research and tracking of ongoing legislative and regulatory changes that impact program implementation and operations with a high degree of organization
  • Presenting strategies to bridge policy, data, and system implementation in briefings and other formats to internal teams and CMS.
  • Providing input or preparing technical reports/briefings based on the expert interpretation of analyzed data.

  • Executing program strategies and leadership goals
  • Providing direct supervision and mentorship of team members.

  • Experience leading and managing teams, mentoring and providing performance management
  • Experience using the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) JIRA and Confluence tools
  • Expert knowledge of health care policy, the ACA, CMS Operations, and related issues
  • Experience coordinating with CMS/HHS to prepare for the public release of regulations and guidance related to agency policies and operations
  • Experience creating schedules and timelines, tracking deliverables and metrics, and providing demonstrations and virtual trainings
  • Consistent quality performance rated valued or higher (Internal candidates)

  • Experience supporting Salesforce services and development

  • Self-motivated and well organized with strict attention to detail

Job Description

Candidates who reside in South Floridaare strongly preferred.


The role is accountable for performance and compliance for assigned protocols and sites in a country. Under the oversight of the CRA-Manager or CRD, the person ensures compliance of study conduct with ICH/GCP and country regulations, our company policies and procedures, quality standards and adverse event reporting requirements internally and externally. Acts as primary site contact and site manager throughout all phases of a clinical research study, taking overall responsibility of allocated sites. Actively develops and expands the territory for clinical research, finding and developing new sites. Participates in internal meetings and workstreams as SME for monitoring processes and systems.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Develops strong site relationships and ensures continuity of site relationships through all phases of the trial.
  • Performs clinical study site management/monitoring activities in compliance with ICH-GCP, Sponsor SOPs, Local Laws & Regulations, Protocol, Site Monitoring Plan and associated documents.
  • Gains an in-depth understanding of the study protocol and related procedures.
  • Coordinates & manages various tasks in collaboration with other sponsor roles to achieve Site Ready.
  • Participates & provides inputs on site selection and validation activities.
  • Performs remote and on-site monitoring & oversight activities using various tools to ensure:
    • Data generated at site are complete, accurate and unbiased.
    • Subjects’ right, safety and well-being are protected.

  • Conducts site visits including but not limited to validation visits, initiation visits, monitoring visits, close-out visits and records clear, comprehensive and accurate visit & non-visit contact reports appropriately in a timely manner.
  • Collects, reviews, and monitors required regulatory documentation for study start-up, study maintenance and study close-out.
  • Communicates with Investigators and site staff on issues related to protocol conduct,
  • recruitment, retention, protocol deviations, regulatory documentation, site audits/inspections and overall site performance.
  • Identifies, assesses and resolves site performance, quality or compliance problems and escalates per defined CRA Escalation Pathway as appropriate in collaboration with CRA-Manager, CRM, TA Head and CRD as needed.
  • Works in partnership internally with GCTO country operations, finance, regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance, legal and regional operations, HQ functional areas and externally with vendors and IRB/IECs and Regulatory Authorities in support of assigned sites.
  • Manages and maintains information and documentation in CTMS, eTMF and various other systems as appropriate and per timelines.
  • Contributes strongly to CRA team knowledge by acting as process Subject Matter Expert (SME), sharing best practices, making recommendations for continuous improvement and providing training as appropriate/required.
  • Supports and/or leads audit/inspection activities as needed.
  • Following the country strategy defined by CRD and CRA-Manager, contributes to the identification of new potential sites and works closely with them to develop strong clinical research capabilities.
  • Mentors / buddies junior CRAs on process/study requirements and performs co-monitoring visits where appropriate.
  • Could perform Quality control visits if delegated by other roles and trained appropriately.

Extent of Travel:

  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 65%-75% of working time.
  • Expected travelling ~2-3 days/week.
  • Current driver’s license required.

CORE Competency Expectations:

  • Fluent in Local Languages and English (verbal and written) and excellent communication skills, including the ability to understand and present technical information effectively.
  • Excellent understanding and working knowledge of clinical research, phases of clinical trials, current GCP/ICH & country clinical research law & guidelines.
  • Excellent understanding of Global, Country/Regional Clinical Research Guidelines and ability to work within these guidelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor/lead.
  • Hands on knowledge of Good Documentation Practices.
  • Proven Skills in Site Management including independent management of site performance and patient recruitment.
  • Demonstrated high level of monitoring skill with independent professional judgment.
  • Good IT skills (Use of MS office, use of various clinical IT applications on computer, tablet and mobile devices) and ability to adapt to new IT applications on various devices.
  • Ability to understand and analyze data/metrics and act appropriately, also in a virtual environment.
  • Experience with conducting site motivational visit designed to boost site enrollment.
  • Capable of managing complex issues, works in a solution-oriented manner.
  • Performs root cause analysis and implements preventative and corrective action.
  • Capable of mentoring junior CRAs on process/study requirements and is able to perform co-monitoring visits where appropriate.

Behavioral Competency Expectations:

  • Effective time management, organizational and interpersonal skills, conflict management, problem solving skills.
  • Able to work highly independently across multiple protocols, sites and therapy areas.
  • High sense of accountability / urgency. Ability to set priorities and handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a changing environment.
  • Works effectively in a matrix multicultural environment. Ability to establish and maintain culturally sensitive working relationships.
  • Demonstrates commitment to Customer focus.
  • Works with high quality and compliance mind-set.
  • Positive mindset, growth mindset, capable of working independently and being self-driven.
  • Demonstrates and projects professional demeanor and communication consistent with organizational policies and practices.

Experience and Educational Requirements:

  • Fluent Spanish speaking skills required.
  • Associate’s degree, certificate or equivalent in a scientific / healthcare discipline together with at least 7 years of relevant experience in the healthcare field, including at least 4 years of direct site management (monitoring) experience in bio / pharma / CRO.

Or

  • Bachelor’s degree (or above) with at least 4 years of direct site management (monitoring) experience in a bio / pharma / CRO.

The position assists with the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of network security technologies to ensure secure, reliable, and cost-effective connectivity across the enterprise.

In this role you will work closely with senior engineers, architects, and cross-functional IT teams to support network security projects, evaluate new technologies, and help deliver solutions aligned with business objectives and established security standards. Additionally, this position assists operational teams with troubleshooting and escalation support for complex network security issues while continuing to develop technical expertise in enterprise network security technologies.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

Network Security Engineering & Architecture

  • Design and implement network security solutions.
  • Develop architecture standards, roadmaps, and best practices.
  • Evaluate emerging network security technologies.

Operations & Support

  • Provide Tier 3 network security support and incident resolution.
  • Manage network security infrastructure performance, availability, and capacity planning.
  • Support root cause analysis for major incidents.

Security & Compliance

  • Partner with data networking and cybersecurity teams to maintain secure network architectures.
  • Support segmentation, NAC, firewall integration, and compliance requirements.

Lifecycle & Vendor Management

  • Manage hardware and software lifecycle planning.
  • Coordinate vendor relationships and technology refresh programs.

Project Delivery

  • Participate in global infrastructure and business transformation projects.
  • Develop implementation plans and technical documentation.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in a relevant technical or business field

Experience

  • 5-8 years of enterprise network security experience in relevant platforms, technologies and services with a focus on Firewalls, DMZ, VPN, Partner connections, etc.
  • Clear understanding of IT Infrastructure lifecycle: Architecture, Design and Operations. Working knowledge of all areas of IT Infrastructure.
  • Diverse technical team experience and working with cross-functional teams
  • Experience in a regulated global environment, preferably in manufacturing, with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Proven ability to work independently as well as in a team environment
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.

  • Managing cloud network and security infrastructure (preferred)

Senior Client Advocacy and References Manager


Intapp serves professional firms across highly regulated industries, and client relationships are among our most valuable assets. As Senior Client Advocacy and References Manager, you will build brand authority and drive pipeline by creating, maintaining, and scaling the advocacy infrastructure that lets Intapp engage those relationships consistently, serving both the client and the business.

You will own the enterprise client reference program and the broader advocacy program that sustains it. The reference program is the core: a structured, operational capability that gives sales, marketing, and other teams access to the right client voices at the right time, without overburdening individual advocates. The advocacy program is the infrastructure behind it, including the operating model, advocate population, participation standards, platform, and reporting that allow the broader organization to participate effectively.

What you will do

As a Senior Client Advocacy and References Manager, you can expect to:


  • Own and maintain the operating model for Intapp's enterprise client advocacy program, including intake processes, participation criteria, and program governance.
  • Establish and enforce standards for how client advocates are identified, onboarded, engaged, and recognized across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary coordination point for advocacy across the business, and drive internal adoption of program processes so the broader organization participates effectively.
  • Lead the rollout and ongoing management of the advocacy platform that will serve as the system of record for reference fulfillment and advocate engagement, including configuration, user enablement, and adoption.
  • Create and oversee processes that enable reference fulfillment for sales, analyst relations, and other teams requiring client validation, matching requests to the right advocates efficiently and without overburdening individual clients.
  • Develop and grow the advocate population by creating automations to identify advocates and working with client success and account teams, using signals such as NPS and CSAT data, to find clients who are positioned and willing to participate. Monitor participation levels and engagement patterns to identify gaps and keep the advocate pool healthy, balanced, and representative of Intapp's client base.
  • Partner cross-functionally with the events, marketing, and sales teams to identify and feature client speakers and voice at Intapp-hosted events and industry conferences.
  • Own program reporting, including advocate pipeline, coverage gaps, reference activity, fulfillment rates, and client participation metrics. Track program health indicators over time and give leadership a clear, honest view of program performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the program, including process efficiency, advocate experience, and organizational enablement, and drive those improvements to completion.

What you will need

Intapp is looking for intellectually curious, self-motivated professionals who like to get hands-on to contribute to the overall success of the business and their team. To apply for this Senior Client Advocacy and References Manager role, you will ideally have:


  • 5-7 years of experience, including a demonstrated ability to build and manage program infrastructure: intake processes, reference tracking systems, participation frameworks, and reporting cadences.
  • Experience working across go-to-market functions (sales, customer success, and marketing) and coordinating shared workflows in a matrixed organization, plus familiarity with reference management platforms or CRM-based tracking tools.
  • Strong program management instincts: you can see where a process is breaking down, design a fix, and get others to adopt it.
  • A collaborative approach that builds trust with client-facing teams and influences without direct authority, with the ability to work across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership, and exercise influence diplomatically to drive alignment.
  • Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain program value to a skeptical sales rep and to a senior leader in the same week.
  • An organized, systematic approach: you track what matters, follow through reliably, and don't let details fall through the cracks.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to build structure in an environment that doesn't yet have it.
  • Experience in highly regulated industries or professional services markets is a plus.

How we will measure success


  • Advocate pipeline health: a growing, balanced population of client advocates that represents the breadth of Intapp's enterprise client base.
  • Reference fulfillment: on-time, well-matched reference delivery for sales and other internal stakeholders, with low cycle times and minimal advocate fatigue.
  • Internal adoption: measurable participation from customer success, sales, and other functions in program processes, rather than a bottleneck owned by one person.
  • Program reporting: a clear, consistent reporting cadence that gives leadership visibility into program activity, participation trends, impact, and outcomes.

What you will gain

At Intapp, you'll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You'll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that's connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities. We'll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork.

Here, you will have the opportunity to:


  • Expand Your Skills: Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.
  • Enjoy Where You Work: Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.
  • Support What Matters Most: Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.

Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

Intapp provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and will make hiring decisions without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please note: Intapp will not hire through text message, social media, or email alone. We will never extend a job offer unless you have been contacted directly by an Intapp recruiter and have participated in the interview process which will generally consist of 3 or more virtual or in person meetings. Please note that Intapp only uses company email addresses, which contain “@intapp.com” or “@dealcloud.com” to communicate with candidates via email. Intapp will never ask for financial information of any kind or for any payment during the job application process. We post all legitimate job openings on the Intapp Career Site at . Certified Financial Analyst CFA) preferred

About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Sr Principal serves as an expert within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group.

Utilizing research and analytical skills, a Sr Principal plays a role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives.

They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

Candidates must have current knowledge of Microsoft’s commercial programs, contracting models, pricing, and discounting approaches as well as a vision for how Microsoft licensing, and overall contracting and negotiations with large vendors, will evolve globally and regionally.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content

  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act

  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward

  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts

  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights

  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings

  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business

  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review

  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy

  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community

  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery

  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred

  • 8+ years of relevant field or industry experience

  • 5+ years work experience in SaaS/software contract negotiations, technology procurement, category management, vendor management or software asset management within a buying organization, outsourcer, consulting firm, or reseller.

  • Extensive, recent, hands-on experience negotiating with Microsoft (within last 12 months).

  • Subject matter expertise in Microsoft licensing with understanding of the negotiation process, software and cloud services market trends, the global landscape, and reseller ecosystem.

  • Experience with software license compliance risk assessment, management, and/or mitigation in a software audit context, particularly with Microsoft, is desired.

  • Experience with other major vendors (e.g., AWS, Google, Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, or ServiceNow) is desired.

  • Provide clients and prospects with compelling, actionable advice regarding their Microsoft pricing and contracting needs, including negotiation strategies and ongoing vendor management, via virtual or face-to-face interactions.

  • Develop and publish innovative, high-impact insights on software pricing and contracting, especially Microsoft, via research articles, webinars, events, and client briefings.

  • Research, analyze, and forecast trends in software, SaaS, and cloud licensing to deliver forward-looking guidance.

  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables

  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions

  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges

  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply

  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements Strong business and financial acumen

  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market

  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team

  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

#remote

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

For ambitious, culturally diverse, curious minds seeking booming careers, Job Duck unlocks and nurtures your potential. We connect you with rewarding, remote job opportunities with US-based employers who recognize and appreciate your skills, allowing you to not just survive but thrive.

As a lifestyle company, we ensure that everybody working here has a fantastic time, which is why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work Certification every year since 2022!

Job Description:

Job Duck is seeking a versatile and dependable Medical Records and Client Communication Case Manager to support a growing legal team. In this role, you will help maintain accurate case information, coordinate medical documentation, communicate with clients, and provide day-to-day administrative support to the firm’s staff. The position is ideal for someone who writes confidently in English, enjoys learning new processes, and can manage varied responsibilities with care and professionalism. As your knowledge develops, you will gradually take on more advanced case management duties, including lien coordination, medical summaries, and demand package preparation. A collaborative, adaptable, and approachable professional will thrive in this role.


• Monthly Compensation Range: From 1,220 to 1,320 USD

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Prepare medical chronologies and summaries with approved artificial intelligence assistance
  • Help identify and manage liens as training progresses
  • Maintain accurate and accessible case documentation in Filevine
  • Request and monitor medical bills and outstanding balances
  • Support attorneys, paralegals, and other legal staff with day-to-day case management and administrative needs
  • Use RingCentral and Zoom for client communication, internal collaboration, and virtual meetings
  • Support the drafting of legal documents as experience and training progress
  • Take on additional administrative and case management responsibilities based on the legal team’s needs
  • Follow up with medical providers and other relevant parties regarding requested documentation
  • Handle incoming calls during assigned phone coverage periods
  • Respond to clients professionally through email and SMS
  • Request, collect, organize, and manage medical records
  • Assist with the preparation of demand packages
  • Organize key medical and case documents

Requirements:

• 1-2 years of experience working as a case manager or legal assistant

• Personal Injury experience required

• Filevine experience preferred

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

• Strong professional writing skills for client correspondence and legal support

• Ability to communicate professionally with clients through email, SMS, and phone

• Strong organizational and document management skills

• Ability to manage medical records, bills, balances, and related case information accurately

• Capacity to learn personal injury case management processes through gradual training

• Adaptability and willingness to manage several areas of responsibility

• Collaborative and easy-to-work-with approach

• Friendly, professional, and service-oriented communication style

• Strong attention to detail when reviewing documents and maintaining case information

• Ability to prioritize responsibilities in a lower-volume legal environment

• Dependability when supporting attorneys, paralegals, and other staff members

• Comfort using case management and communication technology

• Filevine experience preferred


• Location and timezone: Remote, Eastern Standard Time (EST)

• Working Hours: Monday to Friday

• Expected call volume: Moderate (6-15 calls per day)

• Software and Tools Required:

- CRM: FileVine

- VOIP: RingCentral

- Email/Calendar: Zoom

Work Shift:

8:30 AM - 5:30 PM [EST][EDT] (United States of America)

Languages:

English

raw.description:
Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day.

Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead.

At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end - step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves.

We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them.

Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast

Job Description:

About the Role

Darktrace is looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help shape how the world understands and adopts AI-native cybersecurity. You'll dig into what makes our technology different, turn that insight into stories and tools that resonate with customers and sellers alike, and help our go-to-market teams win in a market that's moving faster than ever.

You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with senior product marketing leaders, sales, and product teams —sharpening your competitive intelligence, storytelling, and enablement skillson real deals and real launches. It's a role built for someone who wants to grow fast, learn from experienced PMM leaders, and make a visible impact from day one.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own defined components within a solution area, working under the guidance of senior product marketing leadership

  • Gather and maintain competitive intelligence — battlecards, win/loss input, and ongoing competitor tracking

  • Build sales enablement materials — talk tracks, FAQs, and objection-handling content

  • Develop content including blogs, one-pagers, and sales collateral

  • Support case study and customer proof point development, including coordinating customer input and sourcing quotes

  • Remote role located in EST timezone preferred

Qualifications & Experience

  • 2–3 years of B2B (not consumer/B2C) product marketing experience, with direct exposure to at least one of: sales enablement, competitive intelligence, or customer case studies/proof points

  • Strong written communication skills — this role is content-heavy from day one

  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize technical or competitive information into clear, sales-ready material

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with sales, product, and senior marketing peers without direct authority

  • Self-starter who can take ownership of a defined scope and run with it independently

  • Coachable, with high learning agility

  • B2B SaaS or technology marketing experience (Not required but a strong plus)

  • Cybersecurity or AI industry exposure — candidates with strong cybersecurity or AI backgrounds may be considered even with less traditional product marketing tenure (Not required but a strong plus)

  • Prior exposure to analyst relations processes, competitive battlecards, or case study production (Not required but a strong plus)

  • Salary Budget: $137,500

Benefits:

  • 100% medical, dental and vision insurance, plus dependents

  • Paid parental leave

  • Pet insurance Discount

  • Life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401(k)

  • Employee Assistance Program

As a growing business strengthening its governance and controls, this role plays a part in supporting high standards of integrity and accountability.

Darktrace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Darktrace is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact your Talent Partner.


Employment with Darktrace is at-will, meaning either the employee or Darktrace may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, except where prohibited by law or governed by a separate written agreement.
