Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Strategic and Operational Intelligence Analyst delivers proactive, forward-looking analysis of the cyber threat landscape and translates that analysis into direction and action for Humana's information security organization. You will set the strategic threat picture that guides CTI collection, processing, and analysis while supporting the development of proactive countermeasures that reduce Humana's exposure before threats materialize. Working with operational analysts, the analyst ensures strategic analysis translates into operational outcomes by shaping what CTI tracks, what partners act on, and where Humana strengthens its preparedness. The analyst applies AI, automation, and disciplined analysis to identify what matters most, anticipate changes in the threat landscape, and lead action on priority cyber threats. The analyst is comfortable working directly with threat and security data, exploring patterns, testing hypotheses, and combining quantitative evidence with qualitative intelligence to produce defensible assessments and practical recommendations.

Main Responsibilities

Threat Prioritization

  • Own the actor and threat prioritization framework that guides CTI's operational focus, collection posture, and countermeasure development
  • Identify priority threats and actors relevant to Enterprise Information Protection, Technology, Business, and Enterprise partners; ensure prioritization reflects sector-specific and Humana-specific risk
  • Continuously update the prioritization frameworks as the threat landscape shifts, using AI and automation to help build and maintain them at scale, and ensure they are embedded in how the CTI team and its stakeholders make decisions

Threat Analysis and Reporting

  • Produce recurring and ad-hoc assessments of the current and projected threat landscape, framed for Humana-specific relevance and decision-making
  • Analyze internal and external threat, vulnerability, and security data to identify patterns, assess relevance to Humana, and distinguish meaningful changes from noise
  • Clearly articulate priority current and emerging threats and their implications in both written products and verbal briefings to internal and external stakeholders, including leadership stakeholders
  • Spearhead strategic threat perspectives in support of CTI's engagement with Humana’s strategic initiatives, ensuring policies and planning are proactively informed by the threat landscape
  • Generate industry-leading analysis from concept to delivery with limited direction, sometimes on tight deadlines

Countermeasures Development

  • Contribute to the development of proactive countermeasure packages that translate threat analysis into specific, prioritized actions for Detection Engineering, SOC, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and other consuming teams
  • Work closely with CTI peers and control owners to ensure recommendations are actionable, appropriately scoped, feasible, and tied to current threats

Program Maturation and Tradecraft

  • Influence the maturation and efficacy of the CTI program through continual improvement of analytic practices, tools, and services
  • Review and edit CTI finished intelligence prior to dissemination, ensuring adherence to industry-leading analytic tradecraft standards and reinforcing rigorous analytic thinking across the team
  • Apply AI and automation tools to enhance analysis, improve speed to insight, and deliver higher-impact intelligence outcomes; contribute to how the CTI team adopts and integrates AI into analytic workflows
  • Experiment with data sources, analytic methods, and tools to answer emerging intelligence questions; refine approaches based on what the evidence shows

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of intelligence experience, with meaningful time in all-source cyber threat analysis and demonstrated experience contributing to operational intelligence workflows
  • Demonstrated curiosity and hands-on problem-solving: comfortable exploring unfamiliar data, testing approaches, and adjusting an analysis
  • Experience with the cyber threat landscape, including prominent actors, TTPs, and sector-specific threat trends
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and their application to intelligence analysis, including using AI to accelerate research, structure analysis, and maintain analytic products at scale
  • Experience analyzing structured or semi-structured data to answer intelligence questions, identify trends or anomalies, and communicate the limitations of the data and the confidence of resulting judgments
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to communicate complex subjects concisely
  • Experience conducting analysis of the cyber threat landscape and translating that analysis into direction and action
  • Working knowledge of security controls, enterprise technologies, telemetry, and defensive workflows, with experience partnering with detection, hunting, response, or vulnerability
  • Experience producing strategic intelligence products for senior leadership, including executive briefings
  • Demonstrated ability to influence program strategy and improve of practices, tools, and services
  • Ability to work independently, determine methods and priorities, and deliver under tight deadlines
  • Familiarity with structured analytic techniques, MITRE ATT&CK, and standard CTI analytic frameworks

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience partnering with detection engineering, SOC, or vulnerability management teams to translate intelligence into action
  • Experience integrating AI or automation into intelligence workflows, including collection, analysis, or reporting
  • Experience with ISAC engagement and information sharing across peer organizations

Who we want:

This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As a Provider Sales Director, you’ll be embedded in Provider Partnerships and report directly to the SVP of Provider.

You will own a critical component of Garner's provider segment as a quota-carrying seller, selling our solutions into hospitals, health systems, ACOs and clinically integrated networks, physician groups, and digital health companies. You will run the full cycle from prospecting through close, using Garner's own data as the centerpiece of the pitch rather than a supporting slide. This is a builder's seat: the segment playbook is still being written, and the person in this role will help write it.

What you will do:

  • Own and advance a provider-segment pipeline end to end, from segmentation and prospecting through close, carrying an individual quota against your assigned budget.
  • Build and deepen senior relationships across hospitals and health systems, ACOs and clinically integrated networks, physician groups, digital health companies, and healthcare consultants.
  • Run a data-driven sales motion: use Garner's own data and insights to shape strategy conversations with sophisticated buyers.
  • Partner with Product, Sales leadership, and Account Management, feeding market signal back into the roadmap and handing off closed accounts cleanly.
  • Contribute to a repeatable playbook for the segment: messaging, target-account strategy, and objection handling grounded in healthcare economics and provider risk.
  • Build working fluency across Garner's full product suite and match the right product angle to each buyer.

What we are looking for:

  • 5 or more years in fast paced selling environment carrying and consistently exceeding individual quote
  • Experience as a builder, helping design the selling motion as you go
  • Experience selling into into hospitals, health systems, or other healthcare provider organizations is preferred; if not, experience selling in other complex B2B SaaS environments
  • Executive presence: an articulate, compelling presenter who earns trust with senior buyers and sells with data rather than relationship alone.
  • Demonstrated quota attainment you can name: percentage attainment, President's Club, or marquee logos closed.
  • Intellectual curiosity and data fluency: you ask probing questions and ramp fast into a new data methodology.
  • Creativity when a deal stalls: you generate new paths to momentum rather than waiting on the funnel.
  • Comfort selling while product, pricing, and positioning are still evolving.
  • The instinct to pull in the right internal partners at the right moment, and to route market signal back to the people who can act on it.
  • A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. You're energized by a mission with measurable outcomes, not just good intentions. You engage with AI tools as part of how you do your best work, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes that matter beyond your team’s metrics.

What you’ll get here

You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.

Compensation Transparency:

The target total compensation range (inclusive of base + commission) for this position is $230,000 - $250,000. Individual compensation for this role will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, and applicable laws. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive plan and benefits package, including: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, Teladoc Health, and more.

Few roles offer this combination: work that is genuinely hard, a mission that is genuinely important, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. If that’s what you’re looking for, we’d love to meet you.

Fraud and Security Notice:

Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. Our recruiters use and email domains exclusively. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be a Garner recruiter or a hiring manager from a different domain about a potential job, please report it to law enforcement here and to .

Garner Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. Join Us in Redefining Care

At Advocate Health, we're committed to helping people live well by delivering exceptional care with compassion, innovation, and expertise. We're seeking an accomplished consumer insights leader to serve as our AVP, Head of Consumer Insights & Intelligence, helping shape how we understand consumers and translate that understanding into meaningful business, brand, product, and experience decisions.

In this highly strategic leadership role, you'll build and lead an enterprise Consumer Insights & Intelligence capability that moves beyond traditional research to proactively identify emerging consumer needs, behaviors, opportunities, and risks. You'll partner with senior leaders and teams across the organization to ensure the voice of the consumer is embedded in decision-making from the very beginning.


About This Opportunity

This is an opportunity to transform consumer insights into a proactive, enterprise-wide strategic capability at Advocate Health.

You'll define the strategy, operating model, and roadmap for Consumer Insights & Intelligence, connecting research, behavioral data, market intelligence, consumer listening, and foresight to create a deeper understanding of the people and communities we serve.

You'll also build a high-performing insights organization known for strategic thinking, compelling storytelling, strong consulting partnerships, and an ability to turn complex information into clear choices and action.


What You'll Do

  • Define and execute Advocate Health's enterprise Consumer Insights & Intelligence strategy, operating model, and capability roadmap.
  • Transform the function into a proactive strategic partner that anticipates emerging consumer needs, opportunities, and risks.
  • Embed consumer insights into strategic planning, marketing briefs, product development, experience design, and major business initiatives.
  • Develop strategic insights that uncover unmet needs, motivations, behaviors, barriers, attitudes, and emerging consumer trends.
  • Establish an enterprise Voice of Consumer and Experience Intelligence capability that connects consumer, prospective-patient, and patient listening across critical journeys.
  • Lead brand health and consumer perception measurement, including awareness, consideration, preference, trust, differentiation, competitive positioning, and market intelligence.
  • Build a foresight capability that identifies shifts in consumer expectations, culture, technology, healthcare, and competition and translates those signals into strategic choices.
  • Create knowledge-management and insights-activation capabilities that make consumer knowledge easier to discover, synthesize, share, and reuse.
  • Lead the research partner ecosystem and establish rigorous standards for qualitative and quantitative research, segmentation, concept and message testing, journey research, and other methodologies.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing insights organization with strong capabilities in synthesis, storytelling, strategic consulting, influence, and proactive point-of-view development.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Market Research, Behavioral Science, Psychology, Sociology, Economics, Business, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in consumer insights, market research, customer intelligence, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience, including experience advising senior leaders.
  • Deep expertise in consumer insights, market research, and strategic intelligence within complex, consumer-oriented organizations.
  • Expert knowledge of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies and the ability to select the right approach for different business questions.
  • Significant experience with brand health, consumer perception measurement, and competitive and market intelligence.
  • Experience designing or leading Voice of Customer/Voice of Consumer programs, journey-based measurement, and experience intelligence.
  • Ability to synthesize research, behavioral data, market intelligence, and other information into clear insights, implications, and recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of consumer segmentation, innovation and concept testing, communications research, journey research, and experience measurement.
  • Ability to identify emerging signals and apply foresight approaches to anticipate changes in consumer expectations, healthcare, and adjacent markets.
  • Exceptional executive communication, storytelling, consulting, and stakeholder-influence skills.
  • Strong strategic and commercial orientation with the ability to connect consumer understanding to growth, brand, product, and experience decisions.
  • Demonstrated success building, transforming, and developing high-performing research and insights teams.

Preferred

  • Master's degree or other advanced degree in behavioral science, research, business, analytics, or another relevant discipline.
  • Experience transforming a research organization from a reactive function into a proactive, enterprise-wide strategic insights capability.
  • Healthcare experience, or experience within another complex, high-consideration consumer industry.
  • Experience establishing enterprise brand tracking, Voice of Consumer, and knowledge-management programs.
  • Experience developing consumer foresight, trends, or emerging-consumer intelligence capabilities.
  • Familiarity with modern research, social listening, consumer intelligence, and knowledge-management platforms.
  • Understanding of how AI can enhance research, synthesis, knowledge discovery, and insight activation.
  • Relevant research, customer experience, or insights certifications are preferred but not required.

DISCLAIMER

All responsibilities and requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only responsibilities to be performed by an employee occupying this job or position. Employees must follow any other job-related instructions and perform any other job-related duties requested by their leaders.

Our Commitment to You:

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

Compensation

  • Base compensation listed within the listed pay range based on factors such as qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and/or training

  • Premium pay such as shift, on call, and more based on a teammate's job

  • Incentive pay for select positions

  • Opportunity for annual increases based on performance

Benefits and more

  • Paid Time Off programs

  • Health and welfare benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life, and Short- and Long-Term Disability

  • Flexible Spending Accounts for eligible health care and dependent care expenses

  • Family benefits such as adoption assistance and paid parental leave

  • Defined contribution retirement plans with employer match and other financial wellness programs

  • Educational Assistance Program

Note: Eligibility for programs listed above may depend on your FTE or status (e.g., full-time, part-time, per diem, temporary, etc.); please ask a Recruiter for more information during an interview.

About Advocate Health

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

Job Description: OSP Outside plant Engineer

Overview

  • The Outside Plant (OSP) Fiber Optic Engineer is a critical role responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of fiber optic infrastructure to support reliable and high-performing networks. This position requires a blend of technical expertise, project management skills, and cross-functional coordination to ensure successful delivery of OSP projects.

  • The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in OTDR analysation, and

  • GIS-based fiber management systems. They will manage vendor relationships, lead cross-functional meetings, and oversee multiple projects to meet organizational goals.

  • Strong attention to detail and proficiency with industry-standard tools are essential for success in this role. Additionally, the candidate will ensure that all network documentation is accurate, up-to-date, and compliant with company and regulatory standards.

  • This role suits individuals with a strong background in OSP engineering, a passion for technology, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

Fiber Administration

  • Apply expertise in OSP fiber administration practices to maintain and enhance the fiber network.

  • Fiber Optic Troubleshooting , OTDR Testing and Analysis

  • Analyze OTDR testing to assess fiber optic cable integrity and analyze test results to ensure optimal performance.

GIS and Record Maintenance

  • Utilize GIS-based fiber management systems for network planning and updates.

  • Review construction as-built drawings and maintain accurate and up-to-date network records.

Vendor and Stakeholder Coordination

  • Manage relationships with vendors and cross-functional teams, ensuring smooth coordination of tasks and deliverables.

Project Management

  • Lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring all tasks are

  • prioritized and completed within deadlines.

  • Monitor OKRs and dashboards to track project progress and outcomes.

  • Attention to Detail and Quality Assurance

  • Review and edit splice matrices for accuracy and verify new scopes of work.

  • Maintain data integrity across software tooling systems.

Team Leadership and Coordination

  • Organize and lead meetings with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and progress.

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to team members as needed.

Technical Proficiency

  • Utilize software tools such as FIM, ACC, Gaudi, Ultron, and Glasswork (where applicable).

  • Candidates with experience in equivalent industry-standard platforms
    are highly encouraged to apply, including:
    *GIS & Fiber Management:* IQGeo, 3GIS, OSPInsight, or Esri ArcGIS
    *Project & Infrastructure Management:* Sitetracker, Vitruvi, or

    Procore

    *Workflow & Ticketing Systems:* ServiceNow or Salesforce Telecom
    *OTDR Diagnostics:* EXFO FastReporter or VIAVI Fiberizer
    - Stay informed on emerging tools and technologies relevant to OSP
    engineering.

Documentation and Reporting

  • Create and maintain detailed records, including MOPs (Methods of Procedure), SOWs (Statements of Work), SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), and job aids.

  • Provide regular updates and documentation for project progress and outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum 4 years field experience or Bachelor’s Degree in either

  • Telecommunications Engineering, IT or related field

  • Associate Degree or Certification (Minimum Requirement):

  • Fiber Optics Technology

  • Networking and Communications

  • Electronics Engineering Technology Specialized Training and Certifications (Highly Desirable):

  • Certified Fiber Optic Technician (CFOT) or equivalent certifications from the Fiber Optic Association (FOA).

  • OTDR Testing Certification

  • GIS Certification (for advanced GIS-based management systems).

  • Project Management Certification (e.g., PMP or CAPM) for handling multiple projects.

  • Safety Certifications, such as OSHA 10/30 or equivalent safety training relevant to construction and OSP environments.

  • Additional Knowledge Areas (Optional but Beneficial)

  • Knowledge of telecommunications industry standards (e.g., ITU-T, ANSI, and IEEE)

Preferred Skills:

  • Fiber Optic: Expertise in fiber optic cables and troubleshooting high losses and failures OSP Fiber Administration: Expertise in fiber administration practices

  • OTDR Testing: Knowledge of OTDR (Optical Time Domain Reflectometer) testing and its application in fiber optic cable tesing and associated analysis

  • GIS: Experience with GIS-based fiber management systems and the ability to read construction as-built drawings and maintain records

  • Vendor Management: Excellent communication skills with internal xfn’s and external vendors, including managing vendor relationships and task and coordination

  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and OKR and dashboard management

  • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy in reviewing and editing splice matrices, verifying new scope, and maintaining data integrity in software tooling systems

  • Leadership: Ability to lead and organize meetings, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and provide guidance to other team members

  • Familiarity with various fiber software tools

raw.description:
Workforce Classification:

Telecommuter

Join Our Team: Do Meaningful Work and Improve People’s Lives

Our purpose, to improve customers’ lives by making healthcare work better, is far from ordinary. And so are our employees. Working at Premera means you have the opportunity to drive real change by transforming healthcare.

Premera is committed to being a workplace where people feel empowered to grow, innovate, and lead with purpose. By investing in our employees and fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous development, we’re able to better serve our customers. It’s this commitment that has earned us recognition as one of the best companies to work for. Learn more about our recent awards and recognitions as a greatest workplace.

Learn how Premera supports our members, customers and the communities that we serve through our Healthsource blog: .

About the role of Sr. Clinical Pharmacist, Trend Management Strategies and Programs

Premera is seeking a Senior Clinical Pharmacist to lead trend management, affordability strategy, and clinical program development for high-impact medications. This critical role supports pharmacy savings, member affordability, and cross-functional product development.

The Sr. Clinical Pharmacist researches, develops, implements, and communicates to internal and external stakeholders, and manages pharmacy initiatives, programs and services that ensure clinically appropriate and cost-effective use of medication aligns with, and supports Premera's clinical and financial goals. The ideal candidate has the ability to work effectively across the company with multiple stakeholders and can perform all the responsibilities of the clinical pharmacist with a greater emphasis on broader leadership, management and strategic deployment.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop clinical programs and products to manage cost and utilization trends of high impact medications.
  • Monitor utilization and cost trend of high impact medications under both pharmacy and medical benefits, investigate and prepare trend management options.
  • Develop, implement and measure affordability improvement programs, may include collaboration with cross functional teams using all relevant levers as interventions e.g. formulary, UM, vendors, provider/member outreach, collaboration with care management, contracted network, etc.
  • Manage relationships with service vendors supporting high impact drug management, providing clinical project and program guidance, and monitor program performance.
  • Partner with business counterpart Rx Product Manager(s) in pricing, reporting, product feasibility, marketing, sales training, and program maintenance (dyad model: clinical/business).
  • Collaborate with Rx functional areas in designing and executing the high impact drug management strategies and tactics. Provide guidance to ensure cohesive execution of tactics.
  • Conduct pilots with internal or external business partners, measure outcomes and lead other high-impact efforts such as external benchmarking activities.
  • Develop position statements, outcomes reports, program presentations for internal or market facing needs.
  • Maintain working knowledge of competitive intelligence, market surveillance of vendors and capabilities.
  • Create trend and pipeline reports and insights to inform pharmacy strategies.

What you’ll bring:


  • Pharmacist with an advanced degree (e.g. PharmD, MBA, MHA, MPH) or six (6) years work experience. (Required)
  • Active US Pharmacist license in good standing. (Required)
  • Four (4) years of clinical program development, management or consultation in a managed care setting. (Required)
  • Experience in managed care pharmacy. (Preferred)
  • Experience with project management. (Preferred)
  • Experience with Medicare. (Preferred)
  • Experience with Health Benefit Exchanges. (Preferred)
  • Board Certified Pharmacotherapy Specialist (BCPS). (Preferred)
  • Health Plan claims analytics experience. (Preferred)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage multiple, complex, concurrent projects.
  • Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing; strong presentation skills.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with both internal and external individuals.
  • Ability to work independently, as well as a member of a team.
  • Strong analytical skills; intermediate MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook skills.
  • Familiarity with local and regional health care issues.

Premera total rewards

Our comprehensive total rewards package provides support, resources, and opportunities to help employees thrive and grow. Our total rewards are more than a collection of perks, they're a reflection of our commitment to your health and well-being. We offer a broad array of rewards including physical, financial, emotional, and community benefits, including:

  • Medical, vision, and dental coverage with low employee premiums.

  • Voluntary benefit offerings, including pet insurance for paw parents.

  • Life and disability insurance.

  • Retirement programs, including a 401K employer match and, believe it or not, a pension plan that is vested after 3 years of service.

  • Wellness incentives with a wide range of mental well-being resources for you and your dependents, including counseling services, stress management programs, and mindfulness programs, just to name a few.

  • Generous paid time off to reenergize.

  • Looking for continuing education? We have tuition assistance for both undergraduate and graduate degrees.

  • Employee recognition program to celebrate anniversaries, team accomplishments, and more.

For our hybrid employees, our on-campus model provides flexibility to create your own routine with access to on-site resources, networking opportunities, and team engagement.

  • Commuter perks make your trip to work less impactful on the environment and your wallet.

Join the ASI Partners family as a legacy person you can come back to or refer others to as a government career source and interview for a direct-hire REMOTE opportunity with a major subcontractor on a long-term contract (potential to 2029) serving a massive IT modernization effort at the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).

We are looking for a fully-certified Salesforce Solutions Architect with 5 years+ in architecture, ideally some time with PD2, and experience working on Salesforce/Mulesoft, Agile CI/CD, Security model, Apex, LWC, etc.

Having a Public Trust clearance, a SECRET level government clearance, or having a higher-level clearance would expedite your start date on the contract, but we will also consider strong candidates interested in government service that can stay in place for 4-8 weeks while the clearance process finalizes. WE CAN ONLY ACCEPT U.S. CITIZENS and will verify personal information after the initial interview was successful to move forward.

So, what is the major modernization effort?

Older modernization roadmaps lacked long-term retirement strategies for core mainframes so IRS leadership rolled out a new technical framework stretching through 2029 with heavy emphasis on building a Unified API Layer to unlock legacy data. The IRS plans to wrap up its move toward a single, unified Enterprise Case Management (ECM) system. This platform will consolidate siloed databases and allow employees to support taxpayers from a single interface.

Fiscal Year 2028 Target: This is the projected completion window for updating the critical Individual Master File (IMF). The IMF has processed individual taxpayer data since 1970 using outdated COBOL and Assembly Language Code. The IRS aims to fully convert this core code into modern, developer-friendly Java.

By establishing a solid data structure and robust DevOps pipeline (using tools like SFDX and Git), the subcontractor we are hiring for helps create the stable infrastructure required for the IRS Office of Chief Counsel, the Taxpayer Advocate Service, and the Office of Appeals to safely adopt these modern AI systems.

Tech contests and other perks in addition to great HR benefits

Among great benefits like three weeks PTO, parental leave, and top of the line options for medical/dental/vision benefits and 401K, our subcontractor holds AI application contests that can land you an additional $10K for a good concept, and sets KPI metrics which awards up to $20K additional for meeting those metrics. They will certify you for free including also Agentforce certification. There are other great perks such as optional trips for people interested in cross-project management and discount programs. The company is stable, growing, and has been around for 20 years.

They are looking for a number of people, including the below position, so if you do not meet the criteria for this one, ASI Partners will interview you and we can offer other options if you meet the qualifications for those. Please read the below for the job requirements and qualifications needed for this exciting multi-year project for the IRS and apply immediately if you are interested. We will be choosing our team in the next 20 days already so go ahead and apply now with a solid resume if interested.

Salesforce Solution Architect

A Salesforce Solution Architect leads complex programmatic engineering using advanced Apex, LWC, and legacy integration orchestration (REST/SOAP, CDC, Platform Events) in FedRAMP-compliant hybrid environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Solution Design and Architecture: Develops high-performance, reusable, and reliable Salesforce solutions, including data models, integration architecture, and automation logic .
  • Business Process Analysis: Identify opportunities to improve business processes through Salesforce implementation .
  • Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with project managers, clients, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure cohesive project strategies and effective collaboration .
  • Governance and Quality Assurance: Review developer work, participate in code reviews, and ensure adherence to Salesforce best practices .
  • System Administration Support: Provide support for internal and customer-facing Salesforce environments .
  • Mentorship and Leadership: Advise and mentor teams on technical and functional delivery, guiding best practices and solution implementation.
  • Project Lifecycle Management: Oversee full-lifecycle projects from requirements gathering to solution design, development, testing, and deployment.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Proven experience as a Salesforce Solution Architect or similar role.
  • 6+ years of Salesforce development; Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II (PD2) and AI Specialist required; demonstrated legacy integration and DevOps leadership experience
  • Strong Salesforce customization and configuration expertise, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Developer Cloud .
  • Experience with enterprise-level Salesforce projects using both agile and waterfall methodologies .
  • Current Salesforce certifications such as Certified Platform Developer I & II .
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and analytical skills .
  • Familiarity with integration patterns, application architecture, and security best practices .
  • Owns the full release cycle (SFDX, Copado/GitHub Actions), mentors junior developers, and implements Agentforce custom actions with Invocable Apex
  • Relevant educational background, typically a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields
Salary: $165,000 – $185,000 / year

This is a remote position.

We're looking for an exceptionally sharp AI Engineer or Senior Data Scientist to join and help us build the next generation of intelligent, data-driven products. You'll architect and ship production-grade LLM applications, design RAG pipelines that actually work at scale, and bring rigorous ML thinking to everything from prompt design to system evaluation. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role — you'll work closely with product and engineering to own problems end-to-end.
  • Design, build, and deploy AI models, tools, and agents to automate intelligence-heavy workflows in investment research, portfolio management, operations, and client reporting.
  • Partner with the Head of Data & AI to define the technical architecture for AI use cases, integrating with Snowflake, Databricks, internal APIs, and event streams in a secure and governed way.
  • Implement retrieval augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and prompt conditioning patterns that ground LLMs on Marathon’s proprietary data, documents, and knowledge assets.
  • Design and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP)–based integrations so AI assistants and agents can securely discover and connect to internal systems, databases, and services through standardized MCP servers and clients.
  • Build and maintain MCP servers that wrap key enterprise services (data warehouses, document stores, workflow systems) and expose tools, resources, and prompts to AI clients in a standardized way.
  • Establish patterns for MCP host/client configuration, access control, and observability to ensure reliable, auditable AI interactions with enterprise systems.
  • Implement MLOps and LLMOps practices for both model and MCP-based integration lifecycles, including deployment automation, monitoring, logging, and rollback strategies.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and platform teams to ensure clean, secure, and well-structured data access for AI consumption, including governance of which systems are exposed via MCP.

Requirements

Core skills we need
Python (expert)
LLMs & GenAI
RAG systems
Prompt engineering
AWS
ML / MLOps
Vector DBs
Model versioning
REST APIs
Docker / containers
Requirements
  • 6+ years of hands-on Python — you write production code, build packages, and care about performance and readability.
  • Proven experience building and shipping LLM-powered applications (not just wrappers — you understand what's happening under the hood).
  • Deep understanding of RAG: dense retrieval, sparse retrieval, hybrid, re-ranking, context window management, and evaluation.
  • Strong prompt engineering skills: you know when to use CoT, how to design structured outputs, and how to debug hallucinations systematically.
  • Hands-on AWS experience — SageMaker, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, and ideally Bedrock or SageMaker JumpStart.
  • Solid ML fundamentals: model training, evaluation, bias/variance, feature engineering, and experimental design.
  • Comfortable with embedding models, tokenization internals, KV-cache, quantization trade-offs, and latency optimization.
Nice to have
  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or custom tool-use implementations).
  • Fine-tuning experience — LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF familiarity.
  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks: RAGAS, DeepEval, or building custom eval harnesses.
  • MLOps tooling: MLflow, DVC, Weights & Biases, or SageMaker Pipelines.
  • Knowledge of streaming inference, async serving, and cost optimization for token-heavy workloads.
  • Prior work in analytics, BI, or domain-specific NLP (finance, healthcare, e-commerce).

ABOUT THE TEPA COMPANIES


Established in 2005 and owned by the Paskenta Band of Nomlaki Indians, The Tepa Companies deliver comprehensive and sustainable solutions to federal, state, local, and private-sector clients throughout the United States. The tribally owned companies work independently and collaboratively to provide wide-ranging construction, engineering, environmental, industrial, staffing, and technology services.


When you join Tepa Companies, you have the opportunity to expand your entrepreneurial skill set while growing professionally alongside the best in the industry. You will have the opportunity to impact your team, the organization as a whole, and subsequently, our Tribe.


We seek out top talent to provide the best services for our clients. We focus on being a responsible company for our employees and their families by creating a culture that reflects our core values and offering competitive pay and benefits package. Our benefits package includes comprehensive medical, dental, vision, generous paid time off and holidays, 401(k) plan with company match, life insurance, flexible spending and health savings account, mental health support and resources, short and long-term disability, and tuition reimbursement.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by phenomenal technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

As an AI Storage Platform Architect at NVIDIA, this position will be the linchpin between cutting-edge hardware platforms and real-world AI deployments - translating the capabilities of Rubin GPUs, Vera CPUs, BlueField DPUs, NVLink fabric, and Spectrum-X networking into validated, production-ready blueprints. Work hand-in-hand with storage ecosystem partners to co-develop reference architectures for the NVIDIA AI Data Platform and beyond, ensuring that every layer of the stack - compute, fabric, memory, and storage - is optimized for modern AI workloads!

What you’ll be doing:

  • Architect end-to-end reference architectures for disaggregated inference (aligned with NVIDIA Dynamo), large-scale foundation model training, and agentic AI pipelines — co-developed with storage and ecosystem partners.

  • Design and validate storage-optimized AI infrastructure, including KV Cache tiering strategies, checkpoint acceleration, and high-throughput dataset pipelines that leverage RDMA and NVMeoF fabrics.

  • Define system-level architectures spanning Rubin graphics processors, Vera central processing units, BlueField data processing units, NVLink interconnects, and Spectrum-X Ethernet to improve efficiency across the full AI lifecycle.

  • Develop and publish reference architectures, whitepapers, and deployment guides for the NVIDIA AI Data Platform and partner-integrated solutions.

  • Drive prototyping, benchmarking, and performance validation of AI infrastructure at scale - diagnosing bottlenecks across compute, networking, and storage layers.

  • Leverage DOCA to architect DPU-offloaded data services including storage acceleration, telemetry, security enforcement, and network virtualization.

  • Collaborate with RAG and autonomous AI teams to build retrieval-optimized storage architectures, including vector database integration, low-latency object access patterns, and inference-aware caching.

  • Partner with customers and collaborators in the ecosystem to co-innovate, deliver proof-of-concepts (POCs) and MVPs that demonstrate end-to-end AI platform performance leadership.

What we need to see:

  • 12+ years of experience architecting datacenter-scale AI, HPC, or storage infrastructure as a Principal Architect, Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, or equivalent.

  • Bachelors in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Deep expertise in AI infrastructure build, including disaggregated inference architectures, LLM training pipelines, and autonomous AI system patterns.

  • Hands-on experience with RDMA (RoCEv2/InfiniBand), high-performance storage protocols (NVMeoF, GPFS, Lustre, or S3-compatible object storage), and low-latency fabric design.

  • Strong understanding of KV Cache management strategies, including tiered memory/storage hierarchies for inference optimization.

  • Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and the storage, indexing, and retrieval patterns they demand at scale.

  • Experience with NVIDIA DOCA or equivalent DPU/SmartNIC programming frameworks for offloading data plane and storage services.

  • Proven foundation in networking: Spectrum-X Ethernet, InfiniBand, NVLink Switch fabrics, congestion control, and datacenter topologies.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Proven experience designing reference architectures jointly with storage or infrastructure OEM partners (e.g., NetApp, DDN, VAST, Pure Storage, Dell or similar).

  • Hands-on deployment experience with disaggregated inference systems, including prefill/decode separation, KV Cache offload, and request routing.

  • Deep familiarity with NVIDIA Grace-Hopper, Grace-Blackwell, or upcoming Vera-Rubin platforms and their system-level implications for AI workloads.

raw.description:
NVIDIA's invention of the GPU 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company”.

We are searching for a Senior Backend Compiler Engineer with experience in LLVM code generation for an exciting and fun role in our GPU Software organization. Our Compiler team is responsible for constructing and emitting the highest performance GPU machine instructions for Graphics (OpenGL, Vulkan, DX) and Compute (CUDA, PTX, OpenCL, Fortran, C++). This team is comprised of worldwide leading compiler engineering experts who provide leading edge performance and capabilities for NVIDIA's current and future complex parallel SIMT architectures.

What you will be doing:

  • Guide the design and implementation of a new LLVM based backend JIT compiler targeting NVIDIA GPUs

  • Design and develop new compiler passes and optimizations required to meet the high performance and low compilation time requirements of the compiler

  • Work with global compiler, hardware and application teams to oversee improvements and problem resolutions

  • Apply and adapt the latest compiler technologies to produce premier, robust, supportable compiler and tools

  • Get a chance to influence and work on new GPU architectures

What we need to see:

  • B.S. or higher degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent experience

  • 4+ years of compiler development experience including 3+ years of experience in LLVM with a focus in code generation

  • Expertise in LLVM code generation including instruction scheduling, software pipelining, register allocation, GlobalISel, TableGen, LLVM IR, and Machine IR (MIR)

  • Proficient in compiler design and in performance analysis tools

  • Excellent hands-on C++ programming skills applied to industry standard C++ compilers and development frameworks

  • Strong background in software engineering principles with a focus on crafting robust and maintainable solutions to challenging problems

  • Good communication and documentation skills and self-motivated

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Masters or PhD preferred, with 5+ years of relevant experience

  • Experience developing compiler optimizations and code generation for GPUs

  • Experience in developing CUDA, DirectX, OpenGL/Vulkan applications

  • You should have strong interpersonal skills and be capable of leading and influencing others in the department

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until March 3, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Position Title

Commercial Loan Operations Insurance Manager

Location

Hicksville, NY 11801

Job Summary

The Commercial Loan Operations Insurance Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the commercial loan insurance function, spanning the full loan lifecycle from pre-closing insurance review through post-close maintenance, force placement, and insurance proceeds management. This role ensures that all insurance activities are performed in accordance with bank policy, regulatory requirements, and applicable flood regulations. The manager leads a team of insurance associates, serves as a subject matter expert and resource for internal business partners, and is accountable for the accuracy of insurance records across all relevant systems. This role drives operational excellence, team performance, vendor oversight, and continuous improvement within the insurance operations function.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Supervises a team of insurance associates responsible for pre-closing and post-closing insurance functions, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant processing and responses.

  • Oversees pre-closing insurance review for commercial loan transactions, ensuring all insurance documentation meets bank policy and standards prior to loan closing.

  • Manages flood zone determinations and flood insurance review and approval in accordance with applicable flood regulations.

  • Directs post-close insurance maintenance activities, including ongoing review and coordination with the insurance tracking vendor to ensure continuous and adequate coverage across the loan portfolio.

  • Manages the force placement process, including additional outreach efforts to obtain renewal certificates from borrowers and the placement of force placement charges to client accounts in accordance with bank policy.

  • Reviews and approves general ledger entries associated with force placement activity and insurance proceeds, ensuring accuracy, proper coding, and timely reconciliation.

  • Provides expert guidance and consultation to business partners, including relationship managers, credit, legal, and compliance teams, on insurance-related matters, requirements, and bank standards.

  • Assists with insurance proceeds and loss-related activities as applicable, including coordination with borrowers, insurers, and internal stakeholders to ensure proper handling and application of proceeds.

  • Ensures alignment across all relevant systems to maintain accurate and up-to-date insurance records throughout the loan lifecycle.

  • Monitors work queues, documentation, volumes, service levels, KPIs, and exception reports to ensure operational standards and SLAs are met.

  • Ensures compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, flood regulations, and audit standards.

  • Collaborates with credit, legal, compliance, servicing, technology, and vendor management teams to support insurance operations across the commercial loan portfolio.

  • Identifies and implements process improvements, system enhancements, and automation opportunities within the insurance operations function.

  • Supports internal and external audits, regulatory exams, and quality reviews by ensuring proper documentation and timely responses.

  • Provides coaching, training, and development to staff while fostering a collaborative and performance-driven culture.

  • Assists in operational readiness for new products, systems, and process changes impacting insurance operations.

ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.

  • Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Required Qualifications:

  • Education level required: High School Diploma, GED of Foreign Equivalent

  • Minimum experience required: 4+ Years supervisory experience in a large commercial bank or related financial institution, with direct experience in commercial loan insurance operations or a related function.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) ; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience with commercial loan insurance review, force placement, and insurance tracking vendor management.

  • Working knowledge of flood insurance regulations.

  • Familiarity with general ledger review, reconciliation, and insurance proceeds processing.

  • Working knowledge of regulatory requirements (e.g., FDIC, OCC) and internal controls as they relate to insurance compliance.

  • Familiarity with vendor oversight.

  • Process improvement mindset; Lean Six Sigma or similar certification a plus.

Job Competencies:

  • Thorough knowledge of commercial loan insurance operations, including pre-closing insurance review, flood compliance, force placement, post-close maintenance, and insurance proceeds management.

  • Strong understanding of flood insurance regulations and requirements, including NFIP standards and flood zone determination processes.

  • Familiarity with insurance tracking systems, vendor management platforms, and core loan servicing systems (e.g., ACBS, AFSVision, nCino, or equivalent).

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Word.

  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills.

  • Proven ability to manage operational teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Demonstrates a strong ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders by communicating clearly, engaging in proactive collaboration, and leveraging cross-functional insights. Aligns relationship building efforts with enterprise goals to accelerate performance and drive strategic results.

  • Builds trusted client relationships, whether internal or external, by identifying needs and delivering tailored solutions to enhance the overall client experience.

  • Fosters or supports a positive work culture and productive work environment, displaying importance of effective relationships with customers and stakeholders.

  • Physical demands (ADA): The job requires significant physical exertion and stamina such as repeated bending, reaching, climbing, or moderate and frequent lifting.

International Programs Group (IPG) is an independent third-party claims administrator which provides claims services for Lloyd’s of London syndicates, domestic insurers, self-insured entities, or organizations with high deductibles or self-insured retention.


Today, IPG works with Canada’s largest network of independent adjusting firms across the country. Operating out of Toronto, Montreal, and Vancouver, each IPG office is staffed with specialized senior examiners and qualified desktop examiners. We have regional expertise and are licensed in all Canadian provinces. The successful candidate will work within IPG, a company of opportunity and excitement - we are looking for the right candidate to join us!


We have an existing opportunity to add a full-time Liability Examiner to our team!

Role Responsibilities:

  • Act as an examiner for various Lloyds accounts which involves providing prompt, fair, quality claims service to clients
  • Examine complex liability claims
  • Direct Field Adjusters on assignment investigations
  • Settle claims directly with claimants or their representatives
  • Administer claims payments/settlements through trust accounts
  • Liaise with all stakeholders to ensure client's needs are met

Qualifications & Experience:


While licensing and experience are critical to being able to handle significant examining tasks for a TPA, we are looking for individuals with a demonstrated and proven track record of performance. You will have to be strong technically, a solid planner and organizer, and understand key issues plus provide solid solutions. You will have to be motivated to do this type of work and be excited by the challenges that a rapidly growing organization faces.


We will also consider the following:

  • Your education, with relevant post-secondary education being an asset
  • Your completed CIP courses, or working towards CIP designation
  • Your ability to hold an independent adjusting license
  • Your 5-7 years' experience delivering relevant claims adjusting and/or examining work
  • Exposure to the Lloyd's market would be an asset
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office
  • Your experience positively contributing to a high-performing team
  • Examples of your strong aptitude and ability to work with technology
  • Your attention to detail and your ability to communicate professionally

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Pay: $67,200 - $93,300 CAD Annual - Compensation is commensurate with experience, qualifications, and internal equity
  • Work-Life Balance
  • Remote and Hybrid Work Opportunities
  • E-flex Benefits Program
  • Wellness Programs
  • Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP), including a 2% match for full-time employees
  • Training and Career Development Opportunities
  • Employee Referral Bonuses
  • Employee Recognition Program
  • Employee Perks (access to vendor discount programs)
  • Reimbursement for Adjusting Licenses and Dues

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates throughout the recruitment and assessment process.


Unsolicited Outreach Statement – Recruitment Agencies

We will not accept unsolicited resume submittals from third- party recruiters and hereby request agencies to not contact our employees or managers directly to present candidates. Be advised we will NOT pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume and will consider any unsolicited resumes forwarded public information. We welcome resumes submitted directly from candidates.

Our DIGITALL people are always one step forward: working with top-notch technologies, creating innovations ahead of the market trends, sharing the passion for discovering better ways. DIGITALL operates globally with a team of 1000 experts in 16 locations across 8 countries.

As Partner Marketing & Business Development Manager, you will translate our strategic partnerships into focused go-to-market initiatives that create measurable market interest and pipeline. You will own partner-driven event and campaign planning from joint business priorities and funding opportunities through execution, lead follow-up and reporting. You will work as part of our international Marketing & Business Development team of 11 colleagues and closely together with Alliances, Sales and Delivery. You ensure that responsibilities, budgets, decisions, and success measures are clear from the start.

This is your job:

  • Own joint partner marketing and go-to-market plans for our Partner Microsoft, aligned with business priorities, partner programs and target industries.
  • Plan and manage integrated campaigns, events, webinars, account-based marketing and digital demand-generation programs, including target groups, timelines, budgets and KPIs.
  • Manage MDF, co-op and other partner funding opportunities, including applications, budget tracking, proof-of-execution requirements and internal coordination.
  • Translate partner offerings, industry priorities and customer success stories into clear campaign propositions, messaging, briefs and sales-enablement assets.
  • Work in our international Marketing and Business Development team as part of DIGITALL's Joint Growth Engine together with 11 colleagues.﻿
  • Coordinate execution with internal specialists for content, design, website, marketing automation, paid media and reporting.
  • Work with Business Development Representatives and Sales on structured lead handover, qualification, follow-up and progression from lead to MQL, SQL and opportunity.
  • Maintain transparency in HubSpot and OneCRM and report on campaign performance, lead quality, pipeline contribution, funding utilization and learnings.
  • Build productive relationships with partner marketing managers, Alliances, Sales, Delivery, agencies and external stakeholders.
  • Take decisions within agreed campaign scopes and budgets, identify blockers early and drive pragmatic next steps.
  • Improve partner marketing processes, templates and governance to make activities scalable and repeatable.

Your qualifications:

  • 3-5+ years of experience in B2B Marketing, Partner Marketing, Business Development, or Demand Generation.
  • Experience planning and executing campaigns, events and partner activities with measurable business impact.
  • Strong interest in AI, emerging technologies and digital innovation. You actively use AI tools in your daily work and are curious about applying them to marketing, business development and go-to-market activities.
  • Strong understanding of how leads become opportunities and how marketing contributes to pipeline growth.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing tools such as HubSpot, MSFT Dynamics CRM, LinkedIn Campaign Manager or similar platforms.
  • Experience working with Microsoft or other technology partner ecosystems is a strong advantage.
  • Experience with MDF, co-funding programs or partner investments is a plus.
  • Excellent German and English communication skills.
  • A proactive, hands-on mindset and the ability to independently drive topics from idea to execution.
  • Commercial thinking, strong ownership and a genuine interest in business results.
  • You don't stop at generating leads. You actively work with Sales, Delivery and Business Development Representatives to turn marketing activities into qualified opportunities and pipeline.
  • You enjoy connecting with people, building relationships and creating momentum across teams, partners and customers.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally for partner meetings, events, and internal workshops. Travel is planned as needed (remote first approach) and not a fixed part of the monthly routine.

As a member of the Centralized Support team, the Centralized Support Associate is assigned to Advisory practices for defined periods—generally two to six months—the role helps to help maintain business continuity, protect advisor and team capacity, and minimize disruption during employee turnover, hiring transitions, or short-term absences.

The Centralized Support Associate is part of a national, primarily virtual, reporting into the Manager, Nesbitt Burns Centralized Support. The role requires the ability to quickly adapt to learn the needs, operating routines, and service expectations of different practice needs while delivering accurate, consistent, support within established service standards and operating requirements.

  • Deliver experienced administrative support during temporary staffing gaps, hiring transitions, and short-term absences, helping maintain business continuity and practice capacity.
  • Quickly learn and adapt to each assigned practice’s routines, book structure, priorities, service expectations, and ways of working.
  • Participate in structured onboarding at the beginning of each engagement and establish clear responsibilities, turnaround expectations, escalation channels, and assignment boundaries.
  • Books meetings with prospects and clients, prepares packages for the meetings.

  • Generates reports and documents for IAs and clients as requested and processes items for client accounts and files.
  • Maintains and organizes client database and client files.
  • Monitors incoming and outgoing assets and notifies IA of required actions to rebalance portfolios.
  • Administers and processes documentation related to client files and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitors redocumentation of client accounts on regular cycle to ensure client information and documentation is up-to-date.
  • Mentors and coaches new or junior members to the Centralized Support team
  • Provides team members with support on general inquiries and escalations related to policies, procedures, and processing.
  • Develops rapport and instills confidence with the client to develop credibility and promote a positive client experience resulting in retaining long- term client relationships and delivers an exceptional client experience.
  • Assists with managing a portfolio of clients to retain and grow relationships.
  • Support IA’s in individual client investment needs to provide professional, customized investment-related advice, sales and services.
  • Works collaboratively with BMO partners to deliver the desired customer experience.
  • Follows through on the risk and compliance processes and policies to ensure we safeguard our customers’ assets, maintain their privacy, act in their best interests, and ensure an effectively run branch.
  • Protects the Bank's assets and clients’ assets and complies with all regulatory, legal, and ethical requirements.
  • Maintains the confidentiality of client and Bank information.
  • Completes complex & diverse tasks within given rules/limits and may include handling escalations from other employees.

  • Provide an orderly handover to transition knowledge and tasks when the engagement ends
  • Participate in training and knowledge-sharing, capture feedback and lessons learned, and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve the service.

  • Advanced knowledge of investment process and procedures.
  • Advanced knowledge of administrative process and procedures as contained in Sales Administration Manual.
  • Advanced knowledge of proprietary products and services in order to identify potential products and services to client needs and advising IA(s).
  • Knowledge of compliance practices and regulations.
  • Knowledge of Insurance and group products is an asset
  • Knowledge of Trust and Estate services is an asset
  • Knowledge of Financial/Retirement planning.

  • Specialized knowledge.

raw.description:
About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Director, Analyst serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content

  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act

  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward

  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishingInsights positions across a team of analysts

  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights

  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings

  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business

  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review

  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy

  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community

  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery

  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members

  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred

  • 10+ years of relevant field or industry experience

  • Hands on experience securing AI-driven development of applications including agentic coding and AI generated code, and AI-driven vulnerability discovery, prioritization and remediation.

  • Able to define and articulate emerging best practices for securing AI-enabled applications, specifically managing the risks of AI agents, MCPs, and APIs.

  • Forward-looking understanding of threat modeling, penetration testing and vulnerability management, specifically how these functions are changing with the introduction of AI.

  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediatelyestablish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders

  • Deep expertisewith the technologies, methodologies, and tools involved in application security including SAST, DAST, IAST, SCA with knowledge and experience with vendors like Checkmarx, Snyk, GitLab, Github

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables

  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions

  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges

  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply

  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements

  • Strong business and financial acumen

  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market

  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team

  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. raw.excerpt: About BackblazeBackblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators.
raw.description:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $136M ARR and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a Red Team Security Engineer to join our team!

About the Role

The Red Team Security Engineer continuously validates whether vulnerabilities, configurations, identities, applications, infrastructure, and AI-enabled systems can be exploited by realistic adversaries. The role combines traditional offensive security with AI-assisted and agentic adversary emulation to validate exposure and continuously improve defensive controls.

Key Responsibilities

  • Emulate external attackers, malicious insiders, compromised identities, and autonomous adversarial agents.
  • Validate whether vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses identified are reachable and practically exploitable.
  • Develop and execute realistic attack paths across web applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, identity systems, endpoints, and other enterprise services.
  • Use AI-assisted and agentic techniques for reconnaissance, vulnerability analysis, attack-path discovery, and controlled offensive testing.
  • Test AI applications and agents for prompt injection, tool abuse, excessive privilege, identity compromise, and other emerging attack classes.
  • Validate compensating controls and mitigations before or after deployment.
  • Conduct purple-team exercises with Security Analytics and Security Operations to validate telemetry, detection, and response effectiveness.
  • Translate offensive findings into actionable improvements to architecture, configuration, detections, and response capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Experience in red teaming, penetration testing, adversary emulation, or offensive security engineering.
  • Strong web, API, cloud, identity, operating-system, and network security fundamentals.
  • Experience validating practical exploitability and developing realistic attack paths.
  • Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK and modern adversary techniques.
  • Familiarity with OWASP Top 10 for LLM, OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, and MITRE ATLAS.
  • Scripting or software-development experience.
  • Experience safely using automation or AI-assisted techniques in offensive-security workflows.
  • Experience assessing cloud-native or AI-enabled systems, conducting purple-team exercises, or simulating autonomous adversaries is preferred.

At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you're reading. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Learning, developing, and growing are key parts of our culture. We're eager to meet people who believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in various ways. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. That’s why diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. We believe that our dedication to cultivating a diverse workspace not only allows us to better serve our customers in over 175 countries, but further reinforces our commitment to doing the right thing. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Backblaze Employee Privacy Notice.

raw.description:
TaxTalente ist eine junge Job-Matching Plattform für Jobsuchende und Unternehmen in der Steuerberatung. Unser Anspruch ist es, Bewerbern in der Steuerberatung das Leben zu vereinfachen und ihnen zu ihrem Traumjob zu verhelfen. Auf Basis deiner Wünsche können wir dir deinen passenden Job, aus der Vielzahl von Top-Kanzleien in unserem deutschlandweiten Netzwerk vorschlagen und dir vollumfänglich mit unserer Expertise beratend zur Seite stehen.

Derzeit suchen wir nach einer Steuerfachkraft (Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Bilanzbuchhalter) für eine unserer Partner-Kanzleien in Morbach. Falls du woanders wohnst, ist dies kein Problem, da 100% Homeoffice ebenfalls möglich ist.

Bei Rückfragen kannst du dich gerne jederzeit (auch nach deinem Feierabend) direkt telefonisch an Herrn Becker-Koch über folgende Nummer wenden: 015901431130

Aufgaben

Dein Aufgabenbereich kannst du dir auf Basis deiner persönlichen Präferenzen selbst aussuchen.

  • Erstellung von Finanzbuchhaltungen für Unternehmen unterschiedlicher Größenklassen (optional Lohnbuchhaltung)
  • Vorbereitung und Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Erstellung von betrieblichen und privaten Steuererklärungen
  • Korrespondenz mit Mandanten, Behörden und Ämtern
  • Unterstützung bei Digitalisierungsmaßnahmen
  • Weitere individuell wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche, die deinen Interessen entsprechen

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn du dich in den nachfolgenden Punkten wiederfindest.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Du hast genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen du nicht wirklich profitierst? Dann solltest du einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung zwischen 52.000€ und 85.000€ / Jahr
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf 100% Homeoffice
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Fort- und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen und ein persönlicher Mentor
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient deinen Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an dich, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. Deine Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

  • Du führst keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen du während des Bewerbungsprozesses merkst, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor deinem Bewerbungsgespräch all deine mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
  • Wir führen deine Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens
  • 100% Anonymität – solange du uns nicht das „Go“ gibst und einem Kennenlernen mit deinem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmst, erfährt niemand von deinem Namen oder deinen bisherigen Arbeitgebern – deine dir wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären
  • Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.)
  • Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei für dich
